„Auf Konto importieren“ (phase 6 D176 (3), step 4): the stored document (a card or
depot statement uploaded through Dokumente) imported as a statement of `account_id` from
its original, exactly as POST /accounts/{id}/imports would import the same file. 201 with
the new import; 200 with the existing one when this document is already imported on
that account (idempotent); 404 for an unknown document or account; 422 rule_violation with
a statement.* code when the file is not this account's (statement.account_mismatch) or
cannot be imported (nothing is written then).

a statement file stored through Dokumente with no account for it yet (its
`statement_offer.new_account`), the account is created from the file and the file imported
onto it, in one transaction. The kind, the IBAN or number and the opening balance are read
from the stored original on the server; the body carries only what the person sets (label,
bank, provider, purpose, owner shares). 201 with the account and the import; 404 for an
unknown document; 409 when an account already holds the file's IBAN or number (import onto
it with „Auf Konto importieren“); 422 rule_violation statement.no_account_offer for a
document without such an offer, or another statement.* code when the import refuses the
file (nothing is written then).

The draft Anlage V of the property for tax_year: every line with its sources, the
warnings, the open documents, the 15 % tracker and the statement coverage.

The payments the draft's lines cite (the sources drawer): every confirmed allocation
the draft reads, with its date, amount, category, period, transaction and Beleg, and the
counterparty as a masked IBAN only (D5). Same checks and error codes as the draft.

The year's five steps with their states, „Jetzt dran“, the Belege with their sender and
usual month, every open point with the step and form it belongs to, each form's result and
the whole-return estimate's. A source that cannot be read for the year is named in
`unavailable`; the rest is served.

The current rows (not superseded, not withdrawn), oldest first; include_history=true

post.description:
One new row and its property.tax_input_recorded event. 422 tax_input.scope_invalid,
tax_input.not_current (supersedes_id is not the current row of this kind and scope, or
another current row already answers it), tax_input.allocation_not_confirmed,
tax_input.extension_needs_herstellung (an Erweiterung excluded from the 15 % test needs a
renovation elected herstellung, and that election stays while the exclusion is current),
tax_input.useful_life_not_shorter (a useful_life must be shorter than the statutory life
for the build year, D79), tax_input.movable_asset_year (a movable asset starts in the
purchase year when bought with the flat, else not before it, D80),
tax_input.movable_asset_exceeds_building (its basis with its Nebenkosten share is not below
the building's), tax_input.movable_asset_no_split (no price split selected yet),
tax_input.movable_asset_separate_unsupported (a movable asset bought separately, not yet
supported: it needs its own acquisition date), tax_input.movable_asset_no_purchase_date
(the property has no handover date yet), and for the seller's renovation in the price
(D287) tax_input.price_renovation_no_purchase_date, tax_input.price_renovation_before_handover
(its work begins before the handover), tax_input.price_renovation_paid_before_handover_year
(paid in a year before the handover's) and tax_input.price_renovation_exceeds_building (its
gross with the kitchens bought with the flat is not below the building's share).

queued while the job waits or runs; ready with `export` and a signed `download_url`
(fetch it right before downloading: it expires); failed with `error_code`
(`tax_export.failed`, or `tax_export.too_large` when the archive outgrew 100 MiB).
The export's bytes, SHA-256 verified, as an attachment.

Every owned year from the purchase year through today's, from confirmed allocations
only (D85); the current year is marked so_far. 422 projection.no_rule_set for a purchase
year before the first rule set, tariff.no_file for one before the first tariff file (the
projection answers the same).

Next January through the sale year, with the sale at 31 Dec of that year. The levers
are scenario_id's (a scenario of this property, else 404), else the default scenario in
force, else the defaults with the sale year = the first year on or after the §23 date;
each lever given here overrides it for this read only (nothing is written). 422
scenario.sale_year_before_today (the sale year is not after today's year).

The Nebenkostenpauschale rise test (D155): the monthly costs when each flat_rate
tenancy's Pauschale was set and today, each rate with its sources, and per tenancy its share
of the rise and the verdict (raise above 10.00 € a month, lower on any fall). Information,
not advice; computed on read, nothing stored.

The figures of the letter that tells the tenant of a rise or a fall of their
Nebenkostenpauschale (D155 (7)), for a letter sent on `sent_on` (default today): the
reasons per Betriebskosten category with their sources, the tenant's share, the new
Pauschale and the new total, and from when it applies. 404 tenancy; 422
flat_rate.no_letter when today's check has no rise above 10 € a month or fall for it.

The letter as a PDF to download (D155 (7)), from the same figures as the GET; nothing is

AccountHoldings.title: AccountHoldings
AccountHoldings.description:
One wallet or exchange account. `addresses[].units_by_asset` is keyed by the asset id
(a chain token's symbol is not unique); `movement_ids` are the confirmed movements the
statement summed (D190: the statement's source list).

AccountKind.title: AccountKind
AccountKind.description:
account.kind (migration 0025, phase 6 D156). `wallet` was in the CHECK from the start
so phase 7 adds no migration for it; create_account takes it since phase 7 step 1 (D179).
AccountSource.AGGREGATOR stays refused (account.kind_not_available).

AccountMonth.title: AccountMonth
AccountMonth.description:
GET /accounts/{id}/month?month=YYYY-MM (D269). The balances are the net worth's
(services.net_worth): opening balance plus the lines through the day its statements are
reconciled to, `as_of` that day; None for a month ending before the account's opening
balance, and for an account kind without a euro balance of lines (an exchange, a wallet).
Eingänge and Ausgänge leave out the transfers between own accounts, which have their own
figures; a line not yet confirmed counts by its sign and is counted in `open_lines`.
Amounts are positive sums of each direction. A duplicate merged away counts nowhere.

AccountOwnership.title: AccountOwnership
AccountOwnership.description:
account_ownership row (append-only; a change is a new set under a new
effective_from, an old row's superseded_by names the row that replaced it).

AccountPatch.title: AccountPatch
AccountPatch.description:
PATCH /accounts/{id}. The IBAN cannot change: a different IBAN is another account.
Moving the anchor (opening_balance, opening_balance_on) re-checks every import.

AccountPurpose.title: AccountPurpose
AccountPurpose.description:
account.purpose (migration 0025, phase 6 D156): `rental` is the account the property's
rent and costs run on; every other account of the household is `private`.

AccountTab.title: AccountTab
AccountTab.description:
The Konten page's tabs (phase 10 D279, §7.6 Konten (2)) by the account's kind: both
bank kinds are one tab; the loans' tab reads `loan_balances`.

AcquisitionCostKind.title: AcquisitionCostKind
AcquisitionCostKind.description: Anschaffungsnebenkosten. Itemized so the AfA basis is traceable (principle 2).

AcquisitionCostPatch.title: AcquisitionCostPatch
AcquisitionCostPatch.description: PATCH /acquisition-costs/{id}: null clears paid_on, the Beleg (document_id) or the note.

AddressKind.title: AddressKind
AddressKind.description: wallet_address.kind: change only on Bitcoin (D185), stake only on Solana (D183 (4)).

AfaLine.title: AfaLine
AfaLine.description:
wk.afa for one tax year. amount, basis and rate are None without a selected split.

method (D79): `statutory` is the rate by completion year (rate set; the useful-life fields,
book_value_start and remaining_months None); `useful_life` is the shorter actual useful
life of a Gutachten, the book value at the start of the year spread over the months of that
life remaining at its start (rate None).

AiRetryResult.title: AiRetryResult
AiRetryResult.description: POST /inbox/ai-retry (D50): how many waiting lines were sent to the model again.

Allocation.title: Allocation
Allocation.description: Read shape of one allocation row (migration 0007).

AllocationCategory.title: AllocationCategory
AllocationCategory.description: §8.2. Default tax treatment in the comment (rules/categories.py is the source).

AllocationDraft.title: AllocationDraft
AllocationDraft.description:
What a matcher, a rule, the model or the user proposes for part of a transaction.
amount is signed like the transaction (a debit's parts are negative).

AllocationFact.title: AllocationFact
AllocationFact.description:
A confirmed allocation as the draft sees it. Amount signed (income +, costs −); a 0.00
row may be present and is ignored by every rule (D70). invoice_net is this allocation's
share of the linked invoice extraction's amount_net (a magnitude), for the 15 % tracker
(D56): the whole net for a payment of the whole bill, net × part ÷ gross for one part of a
bill split by its lines (phase 2 D135).

AllocationMethod.title: AllocationMethod
AllocationMethod.description: allocation.method (migration 0007): who proposed the allocation set.

AllocationSet.title: AllocationSet
AllocationSet.description:
One transaction's proposal. Σ amount must equal the transaction amount: checked by
rules.allocations.check_sum, which knows the transaction (allocation_sum.yaml).

AllocationStatus.title: AllocationStatus
AllocationStatus.description:
allocation.status (migration 0007, D23). The only column a trigger lets change, and
only forward: proposed -> confirmed, proposed -> superseded, confirmed -> superseded.

AmountItem.title: AmountItem
AmountItem.description: One typed row of a sum block (dues, training, other).

AnlageNDraft.title: AnlageNDraft
AnlageNDraft.description:
One owner's Anlage N for one year (§5.6). status: certified (from certificates),
estimate (payslip projection or expected pay), none (no pay source; gross_source
declared_none when the owner said „Kein Arbeitslohn“ for the year, D195).

AnlageNYears.title: AnlageNYears
AnlageNYears.description: GET /tax/anlage-n/years: the tax years with an Anlage N rule set file of their own.

AnswerMovementBody.title: AnswerMovementBody
AnswerMovementBody.description:
POST /movements/{id}/answer: what the movement really was. The movement is replaced
by a confirmed row of that kind (the old one kept, superseded_by).

AppCredential.title: AppCredential
AppCredential.description: A slot whose PIN was typed into the app (D196): its name and when; never the PIN.

AppSecretName.title: AppSecretName
AppSecretName.description: app_secret.name (migration 0045's CHECK, widened by 0047), in the card's order.

AppSecretPut.title: AppSecretPut
AppSecretPut.description:
PUT /app-secrets/{name}: the value, stored encrypted and never logged or echoed (a
SecretStr: its repr is stars; hide_input_in_errors keeps a 422 from quoting it). Checked
by services.app_secrets.checked_value per name (app_secret.invalid, app_secret.url_invalid).

AppSecretSource.title: AppSecretSource
AppSecretSource.description:
Where a name's value comes from now: typed in the app (it wins), the container
variable, nowhere (a URL then uses its public default), or typed in the app but no longer
readable (the session key changed): the consumer then uses nothing, never the variable.

AppSecretState.title: AppSecretState
AppSecretState.description:
One row of the card „Zugangsschlüssel (API keys)“. `value` only for a name that is not
secret; a secret's value and its length are never returned.

AppSecrets.title: AppSecrets
AppSecrets.description: GET /app-secrets: every allowlisted name, in a fixed order.

AppUser.title: AppUser
AppUser.description: A person who can sign in. Auth credentials (passkey / TOTP) land with the API PR.

AppliedEntity.title: AppliedEntity
AppliedEntity.description:
One record of an applied proposal and the entity it created or patched (for a link,
the entity the document was linked to). entity_id is null for a skipped record.

AssessedTax.title: AssessedTax
AssessedTax.description:
§5.10: the tax as assessed. est = est_with + kindergeld when the allowances win, else
est_without; Soli and church tax on est_with minus the §35a credit (§51a Abs. 2 S. 1).

AssetKind.title: AssetKind
AssetKind.description:
asset.kind (migration 0025). EUR is an asset of kind cash, so an exchange's EUR
balance is a position like any other.

AssetPatch.title: AssetPatch
AssetPatch.description: PATCH /assets/{id}: the name and the price-source ids only (D167).

AssetRow.title: AssetRow
AssetRow.description:
GET /assets: an asset with how it is priced (D167 (1), D174 (2)). A chain asset
(phase 7 D180 amended 15 Nov 2026) also carries its chain, a token's contract, the
symbol-level asset it is priced as and its spam flag; its symbol is a label
(TokenSymbol: wstETH, USD₮0), so it reads without failing.

AssetsOverview.title: AssetsOverview
AssetsOverview.description:
GET /assets/overview: every depot and exchange account with its positions on `on`
(today by default), their total and the split by class (Depot, Krypto).

AssetsPerformance.title: AssetsPerformance
AssetsPerformance.description:
The Anlagen tabs' figures on `as_of` (today, Berlin). Each portfolio's value is its
`total_eur` on GET /assets/overview (positions, a depot's cash and money on its way);
`etf` sums the depots, `crypto` the exchanges and wallets, `invested` both, each with the
money from or to outside the set only. `total_eur` adds the property's equity (its
estimated value less its loans, the net worth's own figures), an estimate.

Assumption.title: Assumption
Assumption.description: A stated assumption of the projection, as data; the frontend holds the German text.

AutoRate.title: AutoRate
AutoRate.description:
GET /accounts/auto-rate?month=YYYY-MM (D172): per private bank account and in total.
`criterion_*` count only the allocations outside each account's first import; `met`
compares their ratio with the target, None when there are none (the criterion is read on
the second calendar month after the first import).

AutoRateAccount.title: AutoRateAccount
AutoRateAccount.description:
A private bank account's confirmed allocations of the month, by the line's booking
day (lines excluded as duplicates left out): `auto` those the app booked without a
person (D172 amended 15 Nov 2026): the method is rule, matcher_transfer, document_match
or llm and no person confirmed it (confirmed_by null); `by_routing` splits them by who
confirmed (auto_confirm: no person, person: a member). `first_import`: of `confirmed`,
those on lines of the account's first import (the history, D26: the model never
auto-confirms there), which D172 leaves out of the criterion.

BalanceCorrectionBody.title: BalanceCorrectionBody
BalanceCorrectionBody.description:
POST /movement-imports/{id}/corrections: „Differenz als Korrektur buchen“ (D178
amended, 0030). The coin whose typed balance differs, and why, in the person's words
(stored on the movement, never sent to a model). The person types no amount: code books
the typed balance's difference.

BalanceSource.title: BalanceSource
BalanceSource.description: statement_import.balance_source: where the declared balances came from (D21).

BandLimits.title: BandLimits
BandLimits.description:
A figure's limits as the household confirmed them (stored in the default scenario's
`levers.bands`, D248). The reserve's green is its own target (D238), so it takes no green
limit; its red is a share of the target. A side without a limit gives no colour.

BandProposal.title: BandProposal
BandProposal.description:
One figure of bands.yaml: direction, the proposed limits with their origins, the
reference points and the sentence codes per colour (D250 (1)).

BankConnection.title: BankConnection
BankConnection.description:
GET /accounts/{id}/bank-connection: the login masked, the client state only as a flag
(client_data and its MAC never leave the database).

BankConnectionCreate.title: BankConnectionCreate
BankConnectionCreate.description:
POST /accounts/{id}/bank-connection. The PIN is never part of it (D119): it is the
container secret HAUSBUCH_FINTS_PIN.

BankConnectionPatch.title: BankConnectionPatch
BankConnectionPatch.description:
PATCH /accounts/{id}/bank-connection. A changed URL or login keeps the stored client
state only while its MAC verifies (step 1); null is not accepted for any field.

BankCredentialSlots.title: BankCredentialSlots
BankCredentialSlots.description:
GET /bank-credential-slots (phase 6 D163): the slots whose container secret is set,
names only, so the Bankabruf card can say which variable is still missing; and (D196) the
slots whose PIN was typed into the app, so „Bankabruf einrichten“ can say so before a
connection exists.

BankPinSet.title: BankPinSet
BankPinSet.description:
PUT /bank-credentials/{slot} (D196): the slot's online-banking PIN, stored encrypted and
never returned, logged or echoed (a SecretStr: its repr is stars). Surrounding blanks are
trimmed, as the container secret's are (settings._optional), so a PIN pasted with a space
is the same PIN; the length counts after trimming.

fints_url (D196 amended, 16 Nov 2026): the FinTS address the PIN is typed for, the
connection's as the card shows it. The PIN is stored bound to it and a sync to any other
address refuses it (bank.pin_server_changed), so changing a connection's address never
sends the stored PIN elsewhere. Never echoed or stored readable.

BankStatement.title: BankStatement
BankStatement.description:
GET /accounts/{id}/bank-statements: one PDF statement the bank delivered (bank_statement,
D154 (5)), with the document it is stored as and the run that fetched it. Never the PDF.

BankSync.title: BankSync
BankSync.description:
One run (bank_sync, §4.2). lines_* are null until the preview ran; import_id is set
once the run wrote its import (status importing or done), and a run that failed after
that keeps it (status failed); never for nothing_new (D127).

BasisAddition.title: BasisAddition
BasisAddition.description:
Herstellungskosten added to the AfA basis in the year paid, accruing from 1 January of
that year (§5.2). The amount is gross: input VAT a VAT-exempt landlord cannot deduct is part
of the Herstellungskosten (§9b Abs. 1 EStG); only the 15 % test itself is net (§5.3).
Since D137 it may be a private_cost row (tax_input_id) moved by the 15 % crossing.

title.description: a short German title, two to six words naming what the document is

sender.description: name of the authority, without the address

amount_total.description: the amount assessed; when the document holds several Bescheide (e.g. one per buyer of a joint purchase), the sum of their assessed amounts, the one value you add up yourself

tax_year.description: the year it concerns, if stated

cost_lines.description: every cost line of the bill, each written `text | amount | code`: the line's text and its amount as printed, then the code of the kind of cost it is, the only part you choose yourself, one of acquisition_cost, loan_fees, repairs, renovation, insurance, grundsteuer, property_management, hausgeld_umlagefaehig, hausgeld_verwaltung, electricity, professional_fees, bank_fees, other_expense, vat (acquisition_cost for the purchase and its land register entry, loan_fees for a Grundschuld or loan, vat for the Umsatzsteuer line); never a subtotal (Netto, Zwischensumme) or the total; when the document holds several Bescheide (e.g. one per buyer of a joint purchase), each Bescheid's assessed amount is its own line, its text naming that Bescheid only as Bescheid 1, Bescheid 2 and so on, or by its share or base (e.g. 3,5 % von 150.000), never by a person's name, an identification number or a Steuernummer

BescheidExtraction.title: BescheidExtraction
BescheidExtraction.description: A Bescheid other than Grundsteuer, e.g. the Grunderwerbsteuerbescheid.

BudgetClass.title: BudgetClass
BudgetClass.description: Phase 10 D272: where a spending euro sits in the Budget, Notwendiges or Wünsche.

BudgetCode.title: BudgetCode
BudgetCode.description:
One code inside a line or the housing share: its window mean (largest remainder within
its line, D273), the class shown (the override, else the taxonomy's) and the default.

BudgetFixedPayment.title: BudgetFixedPayment
BudgetFixedPayment.description:
One fixed payment inside Notwendiges or Wünsche (§7.10 (c), D300): a recurring series
of D296 that GET /household/recurring lists (active or maybe ended, not hidden as „kein
Abo“) whose newest payment's code the Budget places in the class. `key` is the id of the
series' oldest payment, the opaque id the recurring panel uses (never the payee's words);
`monthly` the expected monthly amount (the yearly total ÷ 12, to the cent half-up); `mean`
the series' payments the Budget counts in the class inside the window, ÷ the window's
months, to the cent half-up.

BudgetHousing.title: BudgetHousing
BudgetHousing.description: D276: the window's spending in the Wohnen group ÷ E; an override does not move it.

BudgetIncome.title: BudgetIncome
BudgetIncome.description: E over the window (D232, D273): its monthly mean, of which the flat's result.

BudgetLineKey.title: BudgetLineKey
BudgetLineKey.description: The lines of the partition, in this order on screen (D272, D273).

BudgetMark.title: BudgetMark
BudgetMark.description:
A line's or the housing share's mark against its target, with the sentence that says by
how many points and euros a month it meets or misses it (D274). Computed on read.

BudgetMarkColour.title: BudgetMarkColour
BudgetMarkColour.description: D274: green when the target is met, amber when it is missed; never red.

BudgetMonth.title: BudgetMonth
BudgetMonth.description:
One window month's partition, exact sums (D273 per month): the lines add up to E, the
one-offs beside them (D308).

BudgetReference.title: BudgetReference
BudgetReference.description:
One published reference point of rules/budget/references.yaml (D275, D276, §3): never a
default, never a target until the household saves one.

BudgetTargets.title: BudgetTargets
BudgetTargets.description:
The household's own targets, each a percent of the income with one place, None while
not set (no mark then). Needs, wants and the housing share are maxima, saving a minimum.
No default and no proposal: a reference's one tap only fills the form (D275).

BudgetThreshold.title: BudgetThreshold
BudgetThreshold.description:
One band of a housing reference: from `above` (exclusive) up to `up_to` (inclusive),
in percent of that source's own denominator; None is open.

BudgetView.title: BudgetView
BudgetView.description:
GET /household-budget?scenario_id= (§6). Below three closed months, `income`, `months`
and `lines` are empty and a to-do says why (D231); with ΣE ≤ 0 the lines stand without
shares or marks and `no_shares` says why (D273).

CarriedField.title: CarriedField
CarriedField.description:
A field of another record of the same proposal (D132): its record key and field name,
dotted as the apply body names it ("tax_input:interest_certified", "value.amount").

CategoryChange.title: CategoryChange
CategoryChange.description: A category's rate when the Pauschale was set and today, for the whole flat.

Chain.title: Chain
Chain.description:
The registry codes (rules/chain/chains.yaml): wallet_address.chain, asset.chain,
movement_group.chain, chain_decoder.chain, chain_pair.from_chain / to_chain.

ChangeCandidateOut.title: ChangeCandidateOut
ChangeCandidateOut.description: One output a change card asks about: its vout, masked address and amount in BTC.

ChangeCard.title: ChangeCard
ChangeCard.description:
GET /groups/{gid}/change: the outputs the card asks about, read again from the stored
original (D182 (3)); `original_missing` when no stored original holds the spend.

ChecklistBankLine.title: ChecklistBankLine
ChecklistBankLine.description:
A confirmed allocation as a checklist item cites it (D142): no counterparty, no purpose
text (D5); the frontend labels it by date and amount and opens its bank line.

ChecklistDepositCandidate.title: ChecklistDepositCandidate
ChecklistDepositCandidate.description:
A tenancy an unlinked deposit line could be split to (D142): it has a deposit (cash),
its proof is missing, it did not end before the line's booking date and no deposit line is
linked to it yet. unit_id: the allocation row's unit (it must be the tenancy's).

ChecklistDepositOffer.title: ChecklistDepositOffer
ChecklistDepositOffer.description:
An unlinked `deposit_in` line of the property, offered on a missing deposit_record item
whose tenancy is among `candidates` (D142). candidates: every such tenancy of the year's
items, by tenancy start then id; the frontend proposes a split only from these.

ChecklistDocumentRef.title: ChecklistDocumentRef
ChecklistDocumentRef.description:
A satisfying document, without its title or filename (either can name a tenant, D5):
the frontend labels it by type and date and links to the document.

ChecklistItem.title: ChecklistItem
ChecklistItem.description:
build_checklist's output. documents: the satisfying documents (present) or the ones
lacking a tax year (incomplete), oldest first; empty otherwise (also for a deposit proven
by its bank lines only, D142, which lists them in bank_lines).

ChecklistScope.title: ChecklistScope
ChecklistScope.description: The item's subject and its non-personal context (no tenant names, D5).

ChecklistScopeType.title: ChecklistScopeType
ChecklistScopeType.description: What one item is about: property, cost row, loan, tenancy, allocation or unit.

ChildFact.title: ChildFact
ChildFact.description:
A child of the household (phase 4b D109; return_input kind child, household scope). No
name and no other identifier: the birth date decides the months, and it never enters an
event payload (only months_in_year does). kindergeld_from: the first month Kindergeld is
paid, when it differs from the birth month.

ChildMonthsDetail.title: ChildMonthsDetail
ChildMonthsDetail.description: One child's months in the year (D109), with the birth month only: never the day.

CommuteComponent.title: CommuteComponent
CommuteComponent.description:
§5.2: the routes' Pauschale (the non-car part capped), the tickets when higher, minus
the employer's tax-free and flat-taxed commute benefits, floored at 0.

CommuteFact.title: CommuteFact
CommuteFact.description:
One route for one period (§5.2). km_car + km_collective + km_other = km; a decimal
distance typed as a string ("25.9") is floored to full km.

CommuteRateTier.title: CommuteRateTier
CommuteRateTier.description: §9 Abs. 1 S. 3 Nr. 4 EStG: the rate per full kilometre and day from from_km on.

CommuteRouteDetail.title: CommuteRouteDetail
CommuteRouteDetail.description:
One route as typed, with its part of the Pauschale (§5.2): the car km and the other km
(Sammelbeförderung, Bus, Bahn, Rad) each × days × rate, to the cent.

ConfirmAllocationsBody.title: ConfirmAllocationsBody
ConfirmAllocationsBody.description:
PUT /transactions/{id}/allocations: the user's allocation set and the "Künftig immer
so zuordnen" checkbox.

Only the set's allocations are read: the rows are written with method `user` and
confidence 1, whatever method, confidence, rule_id or ai_call_id the body carries. A set
equal to the current proposed rows confirms those rows as they are (the proposer's method
stays); one equal to the current confirmed rows changes nothing.

learn_rule: null = the server default (TransactionAllocations.learn_rule_default for this
set); true for a set no rule can be learned from is refused with rule.not_learnable.
The patterns (case-insensitive regular expressions, refused with rule.invalid_pattern
when they do not compile) narrow the rule, and let a line without an IBAN, or a
counterparty a matcher owns (D38), have one.
same_amount_only (D49): the answer to "Gehören die auch zu …?" when other amounts from
the same IBAN are waiting: true = the rule books only payments of this line's amount (the
latest confirmed one of its category, read from the ledger); ignored without learn_rule
and for a rule whose split method checks the amount itself.
rebook_earlier (phase 6 D160, 14 Nov 2026): with learn_rule, when the name rule is refused
only for the name's other confirmed lines (rule.conflicts, rule.too_broad), those lines
are re-booked to this answer's category first, then the rule is learned; refused as
before when one of them is not a single confirmed row of a learnable household code.
learn_deposit_iban (phase 6 D162 amended (8), review, 15 Nov 2026): the box „IBAN als
Einzahlungskonto von <Börse> merken“ the panel shows for TransactionAllocations.
deposit_iban_offer, ticked. Only when true, sent by a person, and the line, confirmed by
this answer as internal_transfer_out (alone or with its fee), is still the out leg of the
link to the deposit the offer named, does the exchange learn the line's counterparty IBAN;
false or missing (an older client, a bulk confirmation) learns nothing.

ConfirmCategoryBody.title: ConfirmCategoryBody
ConfirmCategoryBody.description:
POST /inbox/confirm-category (phase 6 D159 amended 13 Nov 2026, „Alle bestätigen“):
the lines the person saw in the list, and the category they were listed under. Never a
category alone: only these lines are confirmed.

ConfirmCategorySkip.title: ConfirmCategorySkip
ConfirmCategorySkip.description:
A listed line left as it is: its proposal is no longer a waiting one-part proposal of
the category (it changed since the list was shown), or the line no longer counts (merged
as a duplicate, its import not reconciled). A model question is no reason (14 Nov 2026).

CostLevel.title: CostLevel
CostLevel.description:
The flat's costs per month in force on `as_of`: one rate per FLAT_RATE_CATEGORIES, in that
order; `betrkv` is the sum of the three BetrKV rates (electricity left out).

CostRate.title: CostRate
CostRate.description:
One category's monthly rate in force on a date (D155 (2)), with what it came from
(principle 2): the allocations of the payment or the 12 months, or the schedule's tax
input. `from_later`: nothing was known on or before the date, so the first payment (or the
first schedule, or the first 12 months of lines) after it stands for it, as the handover
month's payment does for a lease that began before the landlord paid anything.

CountedCost.title: CountedCost
CountedCost.description:
A cost the 15 % test counts: an allocation (booking_date set), or since D137 a
private_cost row (tax_input_id, no booking_date: the row has a tax year, not a bank line).

CredentialSource.title: CredentialSource
CredentialSource.description:
Where a connection's PIN comes from at the next sync (D196): typed in the app (stored
encrypted, it wins), the slot's container secret, or nowhere yet.

CryptoCoin.title: CryptoCoin
CryptoCoin.description: One coin on one account (FIFO is per account and coin, D188 (1)).

CryptoHoldings.title: CryptoHoldings
CryptoHoldings.description: GET /holdings/crypto: the Krypto tab on `on` (today by default).

CryptoLot.title: CryptoLot
CryptoLot.description:
An open lot as the tab shows it: tax-free today or from `tax_free_from`, its value at
the coin's price, and what resolves a missing cost. A lot of source `unknown` (an in-leg
no transfer explains, a correction) has no price need: its cost is unknown for another
reason, and the tab names that instead.

CryptoRefreshState.title: CryptoRefreshState
CryptoRefreshState.description:
GET /crypto/refresh, and POST's answer.

status: `idle` (never pressed), `running` (queued or reading), `succeeded`, `failed`.
queued (POST only): whether this press queued a new run; false while one runs or one
finished less than two minutes ago, whose state is then returned (one at a time per
household). spot_read_at: the moment of the newest price read on demand today (Berlin),
null when none was read today. prices_done: while a run is `running`, whether it has
already stored its current prices (a price read on demand at or after the run started),
so the card says the wallets are still being checked; false otherwise, and false through
a run that stored no price at all.

The counts of the newest run when it succeeded (its workspace.crypto_refreshed event),
else null: `stored`, the held coins that got a current price; `unpriced`, those with a
price source (a Kraken pair or a CoinGecko id) that kept their daily close;
`wallets_failed`, the wallet addresses that could not be read; `wallets_aborted`, the
wallet read stopped as a whole, so no address count is known.

Currency.title: Currency
Currency.description:
transaction.currency. v1 is EUR only (one value, kept as a CHECK'd set like
InvitePurpose).

DateCorrection.title: DateCorrection
DateCorrection.description: Corrects a milestone date: purchase date (Übergang) or move-in.

DatedFlow.title: DatedFlow
DatedFlow.description:
One flow of the IRR (D89): −E₀ on the purchase date, each year's net cash on 31 Dec,
the net sale proceeds on the sale date.

Debt.title: Debt
Debt.description: D239, §5.3. Annualised from n months when n < 12.

DebtGap.title: DebtGap
DebtGap.description: A debt figure whose denominator is 0 or below (§5.3).

DeclareBalanceBody.title: DeclareBalanceBody
DeclareBalanceBody.description: POST /imports/{id}/balances: the closing balance Luis reads in online banking.

DeclareHoldingsBody.title: DeclareHoldingsBody
DeclareHoldingsBody.description:
POST /movement-imports/{id}/holdings: the balance per asset the exchange shows, typed
once per import (the pending_balance precedent of D21).

DepositIbanOffer.title: DepositIbanOffer
DepositIbanOffer.description:
Phase 6 D162 amended (8), review (15 Nov 2026): a private bank debit that is the out
leg of a current link (the matcher's or a person's) to an exchange's EUR deposit, while
the exchange has no deposit IBAN and the line's IBAN could become it
(accounts.deposit_iban_outcome learned). The panel offers the box „IBAN als
Einzahlungskonto von <exchange_label> merken“, ticked, for an answer of
internal_transfer_out (alone or with bank_fees), and shows `text`: the paired deposit by
date and amount and what learning does (rules.matching.deposit_iban_offer_text).

DepositReceipt.title: DepositReceipt
DepositReceipt.description:
GET /tenancies/{id}/deposits: one Kaution payment received (a tenancy.deposit_received
event; the latest of its chain, should one ever be corrected).

title.description: a short German title, two to six words naming what the document is

DepotDocumentStatus.title: DepotDocumentStatus
DepotDocumentStatus.description:
One document of the depot's Postbox list: its subtype, title and date as typed, and
the status of its latest reading (None: stored, never read, e.g. while the switch
„Private Konten mit KI zuordnen“ is off, or a tax certificate, read in phase 8).

DepotIbanProposal.title: DepotIbanProposal
DepotIbanProposal.description:
The IBAN a depot's cash statement prints (phase 6 step 4, D156 amended), masked; POST
/accounts/{id}/iban with its import_id confirms it (the D176 (4) pattern).

title.description: a short German title, two to six words naming what the document is

report_date.description: the date the positions are stated for (Stichtag)

positions.description: every position the report lists, one item per security, each written `ISIN | name | units | price | value | currency`, as printed (the units without ST, the price the Kurs, the value the Kurswert); never a subtotal, the total row, an account's cash or the Kaufpreis

trades.description: every trade of the report's Wertpapierumsätze list, one item per trade, each written `ISIN | trade date | units | amount | reference`, as printed: the trade date the Schlußtag, the units signed (a sale negative), the amount the Ausmachender Betrag with its sign (a purchase negative), the reference the Referenz; unbekannt for a part the row does not state; never the Depot-Nr.

DepotReportExtraction.title: DepotReportExtraction
DepotReportExtraction.description:
Quartalsbericht (depot_report, D165 (3)): the positions on a date and the trades the
report lists, from which code proposes holding_statement rows. The list of trades runs
from the mandate's start, so a later report repeats the earlier ones.

DisbursementCorrection.title: DisbursementCorrection
DisbursementCorrection.description:
POST /loans/{id}/corrections/disbursement: the payout date and/or the principal; an
absent (or null) field keeps the recorded value.

title.description: a short German title, two to six words naming what the document is

gross_per_unit.description: the distribution per unit before taxes, in the note's currency

gross_amount.description: the gross distribution before taxes, in the note's currency (Betrag)

withholding_tax.description: foreign withholding tax (Quellensteuer) deducted, without sign, in the note's currency; 0,00 when none

german_taxes.description: German taxes deducted in the note's currency, summed without sign: Kapitalertragsteuer, Solidaritätszuschlag and Kirchensteuer

net_amount.description: the amount credited, in the note's currency (Ausmachender Betrag)

currency.description: the currency of the note's amounts, as a three-letter code

fx_rate.description: the exchange rate (Devisenkurs) as printed, units of the note's currency per euro; unbekannt when the note is in EUR

gross_amount_eur.description: the gross distribution in euro (Ausschüttungsbetrag in the tax section); the gross amount when the note is in EUR

german_taxes_eur.description: the German taxes in euro from the tax section, summed without sign: Kapitalertragsteuer, Solidaritätszuschlag and Kirchensteuer

net_amount_eur.description: the amount credited in euro (Ausmachender Betrag in EUR)

DistributionNoteExtraction.title: DistributionNoteExtraction
DistributionNoteExtraction.description:
Erträgnisabrechnung / Ausschüttung (distribution_note, D165 (2)). A note in a fund's
currency states its euro side separately: the rate, the gross in the tax section and the
amount credited in euro.

Document.title: Document
Document.description: One per file per workspace: re-uploading the same bytes returns this row.

DocumentDetail.title: DocumentDetail
DocumentDetail.description: GET /documents/{id}: one read transaction over the document and its layers.

DocumentExplanation.title: DocumentExplanation
DocumentExplanation.description:
A depot document in plain words (phase 6 D177): what it is, what it means for the
account (its own figures filled in by code), and what Hausbuch does with it. Rule data
filled by code (rules/depot_explain.yaml), never by the model.

DocumentExtraction.title: DocumentExtraction
DocumentExtraction.description:
Append-only. A new version is a new row; the highest version is current.

kind (phase 2, migration 0005) says which field set `fields` holds: `manual` is
ManualDocumentFields, every other kind its per-type model in schemas/extraction.py. The
kind is a column, not a key inside the fields, so the union is resolved from it here
rather than by a Pydantic discriminator. ai_call_id is the call an `ai` version came from
(D18); a `manual` version on top of it (Luis edited extracted fields) has none.

DocumentLink.title: DocumentLink
DocumentLink.description: Links a document to exactly one entity (the thing it proves).

DocumentListItem.title: DocumentListItem
DocumentListItem.description:
A row of the Dokumente list (GET /documents): the document with its section, computed
on read from what the document is and what relies on it (phase 10 D282,
rules/document_section.py), never stored. Only the list carries it, since a link or a cost
row added later changes it.

DocumentSection.title: DocumentSection
DocumentSection.description:
Which part of the app a document belongs to on Dokumente (phase 10 D282): computed by
code on read (rules/document_section.py), never stored. The members are in priority
order: a document two sections could claim takes the first.

DocumentSubtype.title: DocumentSubtype
DocumentSubtype.description: Finer typing where retention or the AfA basis depends on it.

DocumentType.title: DocumentType
DocumentType.description: The classifier's output set (AI layer). Phase 1 sets it by hand.

DocumentTyping.title: DocumentTyping
DocumentTyping.description: What a person (phase 1) or the classifier (phase 2) says the document is.

DocumentTypingBody.title: DocumentTypingBody
DocumentTypingBody.description:
PUT /documents/{id}/typing. `shown_version` is the extraction version the hand fields
were shown from (0: none yet), required with `fields`; a save from a version that is no
longer current is refused (document.extraction_stale, phase 2 D37).

DocumentUploadResult.title: DocumentUploadResult
DocumentUploadResult.description:
POST /documents with ai = true (§6.1): the document plus the queued proposal to
poll. proposal_id is null when the upload did not ask for a proposal.

DraftWarning.title: DraftWarning
DraftWarning.description:
A warning as data; the frontend holds the German text. params are strings (amounts as
decimal strings, dates ISO) so the draft's JSON is the same before and after a round trip.
severity defaults from WARNING_SEVERITY and must agree with it.

EffectiveSplit.title: EffectiveSplit
EffectiveSplit.description:
§7.11 (a) 2: the mix the goal's walk invests the money above the reserve in. A kind
without a typed yearly rate is in `left_out` and the other kind takes its share; when
every kind with a share is left out, `shares` is None (nothing moves) and the to-do
„Rendite eintragen“ names them. Computed by rules/investment_split.py from the levers and the
stored rows, on every read.

EntityType.title: EntityType
EntityType.description: Entities that carry events. Also the prefix of every event type.

EquipmentFact.title: EquipmentFact
EquipmentFact.description: One work item or subscription (D108). bought_on may lie before the tax year.

EquipmentItemDetail.title: EquipmentItemDetail
EquipmentItemDetail.description:
§5.5: one item's amount in the year. method `full`: the base in the purchase year only
(a subscription, a low-value item, a class written off at once); `depreciated`: the base
over `life_months` from the purchase month, `months_in_year` of them in this year.

ErrorKind.title: ErrorKind
ErrorKind.description: ErrorResponse.error: the stable string the frontend switches on.

ErrorResponse.title: ErrorResponse
ErrorResponse.description: Every non-2xx body. Only the fields that apply to `error` are set (see ErrorKind).

EstimateLineSources.title: EstimateLineSources
EstimateLineSources.description:
What each line of the whole-return estimate came from, so the Gesamt card opens the
sources line by line (ReturnEstimate.sources stays their union). The Anlage N and V lines
carry theirs on OwnerIncome and PropertyIncome.

EtfPositionToday.title: EtfPositionToday
EtfPositionToday.description:
One fund on the ETF tab (phase 10 D280): the row shows `units` and `value_today_eur`,
both copied from the Übersicht's OverviewPosition of the same account, asset and day
(`rules.valuation`, D167), with the price's source and day in `price`; never a sum or a
product of its own. `from_report` with `price.on` is „Kurs aus dem Bericht vom …“
(D174 (4)); a fund past its last reconciled report has no value and `not_valued_reason`
valuation.not_valued (D165 (3), „siehe Zu prüfen“). `gain_today_eur` is
`value_today_eur` − `cost_eur` while both are shown. The inherited report figures
(`report_*`, `value_eur`, `gain_eur`, `reconciled`) are the panel's check only. A fund
the Übersicht does not hold on `on` (0 units then) has no value.

EtfToday.title: EtfToday
EtfToday.description:
GET /assets/etf?on=: every depot account with its funds valued on `on` (today by
default) as the Übersicht and the net worth value them (D280), and the depot's
documents. `total_eur` is Σ of the accounts' values.

ExchangeImport.title: ExchangeImport
ExchangeImport.description: An import on the exchange account's page, with its balances per asset.

ExchangeMovementRow.title: ExchangeMovementRow
ExchangeMovementRow.description:
GET /accounts/{id}/movements: a current movement with its asset's symbol and, while it
waits, its question (an error code) and the kinds a person may answer.

ExchangeOverview.title: ExchangeOverview
ExchangeOverview.description:
GET /accounts/{id}/exchange: the exchange account's page. `withdrawals_open` counts
the crypto withdrawals without network and hash; on Binance they are the to-do
„Auszahlungsverlauf hochladen“ (D178 (4)), named by `todos`. `learned` the live deposit
addresses and withdrawal pairs (D261), oldest first.

ExchangePosition.title: ExchangePosition
ExchangePosition.description:
Σ current movements of one asset on the exchange account (EUR with the trades' EUR
legs, D178 (6)), and its last typed balance.

ExchangeUpload.title: ExchangeUpload
ExchangeUpload.description:
POST /accounts/{id}/movement-imports. A transaction export gives its import (the same
file again returns the stored one); Binance's withdrawal history gives no import, only
how many withdrawals it completed and how many still have no network and hash.

ExplanationReason.title: ExplanationReason
ExplanationReason.description: Why the template text was used (plan_explanation.reason).

ExtractedValue.title: ExtractedValue
ExtractedValue.description:
One field of a per-type extraction, or of a proposal record.

checks say what code verified: `cited` (the API attached a citation, so `source` is set),
`value_in_quote` (the value is recoverable from the cited text), `validates` (the value
passes the target field's Pydantic type), `derived` (code computed it from the fields in
`derived_from`, e.g. building_share). The confidence is a function of the checks, computed
by rules.extraction_parse (fixture extraction_parse.yaml); this model only enforces that
the checks are consistent with the other fields.

ExtractionKind.title: ExtractionKind
ExtractionKind.description:
document_extraction.kind and proposal.kind (migration 0005): which field set an
extraction holds. `manual` is phase 1's ManualDocumentFields; the others are the per-type
models in schemas/extraction.py.

FieldDecision.title: FieldDecision
FieldDecision.description:
What the user did with one proposed value. Recorded per field on apply, without the
value (proposal.applied event, eval record).

FieldError.title: FieldError
FieldError.description: One validation error, whitelisted to these three keys: never input, ctx or url (§3.6).

FieldOption.title: FieldOption
FieldOption.description:
A value the review offers for one field with one click (D139): the field's value as
the apply body sends it and its label, e.g. "61.40" and "WE 3 · 2. OG links · 61,40 m²"
for a Wohnflächenberechnung's dwelling the code could not pick by itself.

FilingCheck.title: FilingCheck
FilingCheck.description:
§46 Abs. 2 EStG. deadline: 31 July of the following year (§149 Abs. 2 S. 1 AO), moved
to the next working day when that is a Saturday, Sunday or a nationwide public holiday
(§108 Abs. 3 AO); computed by rule, never typed. Regional holidays are not considered.

FlatChange.title: FlatChange
FlatChange.description:
The month the flat's default scenario first gives another monthly result than the
first plan month (phase 4's projected year after the newest closed month's year, §7.1),
computed without one-offs: that month's flat result, the flat result of the months before
it (`before_is_mean`: that is the window's measured mean, „statt im Schnitt“), and each
path's amount to the reserve from then on (the month's investable less the plans that
continue on that path), in the order of `HouseholdPlan.paths`.

FlatRateCheck.title: FlatRateCheck
FlatRateCheck.description:
GET /properties/{id}/flat-rate-check (D155): information, not advice; §560 BGB decides.

`levels` are the cost levels on every tenancy's set_on and on `as_of` (today), distinct and
ascending; `tenancies` the flat_rate tenancies in force on `as_of`; both empty without one.
`settlements` are the hints of the 12 months up to `as_of`.

FlatRateLetterFigures.title: FlatRateLetterFigures
FlatRateLetterFigures.description:
GET /tenancies/{id}/flat-rate-letter (D155 (7)): the figures of the letter for one
tenancy's rise or fall, from the FlatRateCheck of `as_of` (today); the dialog shows them
before the PDF is made and the PDF prints exactly these.

`reasons`: the BetrKV categories with a cost then or now, in FLAT_RATE_BETRKV order.
`new_pauschale` = pauschale + rise, to the cent, never below 0.00; `new_total` = the cold
rent in force on the later of `as_of` and `starts_on`, + new_pauschale. `starts_on`: for a
raise the first day of the month after next from `sent_on` (§560 Abs. 2 BGB), for a lower
the date the cost fell (§560 Abs. 3 BGB).

FlatRateLetterRequest.title: FlatRateLetterRequest
FlatRateLetterRequest.description:
POST /tenancies/{id}/flat-rate-letter (D155 (7)): what the dialog asks. The sender's
name and address lines are printed and never stored (the browser may remember them).

FormStatus.title: FormStatus
FormStatus.description: Whether a form mapping is the year's published form or a copy of an earlier one (§4.3).

Fraction.title: Fraction
Fraction.description: An exact share: ownership (1/2) or Miteigentumsanteil (85/1000).

title.description: a short German title, two to six words naming what the document is

street.description: street of the property the document concerns

dwellings.description: every dwelling the document lists, one item per Wohnung, each written `label | Wohnfläche | MEA | Lage`: the dwelling's label as printed (e.g. WE 3, Wohnung Nr. 3), its Wohnfläche in m² as printed, its Miteigentumsanteil as printed (e.g. 85/1000) and its location in the building (e.g. 2. OG links), unbekannt for a part the row does not state; one item for a document about one flat; never a single room, a sum or a total row

remaining_useful_life.description: the Restnutzungsdauer or tatsächliche Nutzungsdauer of the building the Gutachten concludes, in years as written (e.g. 21 Jahre); never the Gesamtnutzungsdauer, the building's age or a life the Gutachten only quotes from a table

valuation_date.description: the Wertermittlungsstichtag or Bewertungsstichtag the remaining life is stated for; never the date the Gutachten was written or signed

lender.description: the bank that gave the loan

contract_number.description: Darlehensnummer / Vertragsnummer; when none is printed, the loan's Kontonummer. The number only, without its label

GeneralExtraction.title: GeneralExtraction
GeneralExtraction.description:
The general reading (D130): title and date for every document without a reader of its
own, plus the one field set its subtype's group needs to find its link (D131): the
property's address for the property, WEG, running-costs and tenancy groups, the lender and
contract number for the loan group. A request asks only those (asked_fields); an
owner's home address is never asked. A Wohnflächenberechnung (building_records) is also
asked its list of dwellings (D139), a Gutachten (appraisal) its remaining useful life and
Stichtag (D147).

Goal.title: Goal
Goal.description:
The household's own goal (D289 (1)): a target and a due month the household typed; the
app proposes neither. `target` is euros, or months for `reserve_months`. Only the shape is
checked here; that the due month lies after the current month is refused when a scenario
is saved (services.household_scenarios.check_levers), so a stored goal whose month has
passed still reads.

GoalAssumption.title: GoalAssumption
GoalAssumption.description:
An assumption the walk makes that the household can replace (D301 (a) 5): a property
without a default scenario is kept at today's value.

GoalBalanced.title: GoalBalanced
GoalBalanced.description:
„Ausgewogener Weg“ (D302), shown first whenever the walk without change misses: half
of the extra cut from the wants by their means, each want at most to half its mean or, with
the household's wants target, to that share of the income; `saving_extra` the smallest
whole euro a month that with these cuts reaches the target (None above the mean income);
`moved_to_saving` what the limit left open and the saving takes on.

GoalBudget.title: GoalBudget
GoalBudget.description: One category of a spending scenario: its measured mean and its budget (D272's class).

GoalChoice.title: GoalChoice
GoalChoice.description:
What the household chose for its goal, each with the day chosen (§7.9 (d), (e)). The
adopted budget itself is the scenario's `spending_changes` („Als Budget übernehmen“
supersedes the default scenario with them); `investment` is a placeholder for §7.9 (e).

GoalInvestment.title: GoalInvestment
GoalInvestment.description: The return the household follows (`goal_choice.investment`, „Diesem Weg folgen“).

GoalIssue.title: GoalIssue
GoalIssue.description: Why a set goal has no word yet; the card shows the plan's to-dos or the sentence.

GoalKind.title: GoalKind
GoalKind.description: What a household goal measures (phase 10 §7.9 (d), D289 (1)).

GoalLeftOut.title: GoalLeftOut
GoalLeftOut.description:
What the mix left out and named, with its share of the invested value (or of the
saved split while nothing is held); its weight went to the rest pro rata.

GoalMoreReturn.title: GoalMoreReturn
GoalMoreReturn.description:
Route 3 „Mehr Rendite“ (§7.11 (c) 3, D303, D310 amended): the one yearly return for
funds and crypto together that reaches the target by the due month (`needed_return`,
smallest to 0.1 % between −50 % and +100 %), against every window of `window_years` in the
mix's history: `reached_windows` of `windows` reached it, their `median` and `best`
annualised (each floored to 0.1 %), and the `verdict`. `thin` (under 5 windows) is shown
but never decides the word. Without a count `available` is false and `reason` says why;
`out_of_range` still shows the windows.

GoalMoreSaving.title: GoalMoreSaving
GoalMoreSaving.description:
Route 2 „Mehr anlegen“ (D302): the smallest whole-euro `extra` a month from next month
to the due month that reaches the target on the walk; `noetig` = Heute + extra, None when
the extra is above the mean income. It never decides the word.

GoalPoint.title: GoalPoint
GoalPoint.description:
One point of the goal's chart (mockup 19f „So wie jetzt“): the goal's value at a month's
end on the walk without change, and on the balanced route's walk while it closes. The
points are the first walked month, each December before the due month, and the due month.

GoalReferenceSource.title: GoalReferenceSource
GoalReferenceSource.description: A series the mix rests on, named in the answer (§7.11 „Route 3 …“ 7).

GoalRouteReason.title: GoalRouteReason
GoalRouteReason.description:
Why route 3 has no count (§7.11 „Route 3 as decided for the build“ 5, 6; D310
amended). `not_built` went with route 3's build.

GoalSale.title: GoalSale
GoalSale.description:
A property walked to its own sale year (D301 (a) 4): the year and phase 4's net
proceeds, which the walk puts on the reserve row in its December (mockup 19f „Verkauf“).

GoalScenario.title: GoalScenario
GoalScenario.description:
A spending scenario (§7.9 (d) 3). `cut` is what it takes off the spending each month
(the Σ of its codes' cuts), `rest` what it still misses a month when its codes cannot give
the cut, `saving` „Heute im Monat“ + `cut`. `spending_changes` are what „Als Budget
übernehmen“ stores (D263 planned amounts from next month to the due month); `closes` is
true when the projection with them reaches the target by the due month.

GoalSpending.title: GoalSpending
GoalSpending.description: The spending scenario the household adopted for its goal (§7.9 (d)).

GoalTracking.title: GoalTracking
GoalTracking.description:
`GET /household-goal/tracking`: „Für euer Ziel“ on Anlagen › Übersicht. Since the day
the household chose to follow a return: the money put into its funds and crypto accounts
(a depot counted in the reserve left out, D304) against what the walk of that route plans
to invest by now, and the value change of those accounts against the change the return
implies by now; one word by code. Every figure computed on read, never stored.

GoalTrackingReason.title: GoalTrackingReason
GoalTrackingReason.description: Why the card is not shown (the first three) or shows no word.

GoalUnreachable.title: GoalUnreachable
GoalUnreachable.description:
§7.9 (d) 4: what the household reaches instead. `later` is the month the goal is
reached without change (None beyond the projection); `reaches_by_due` the value at the due
month without change.

GoalVerdict.title: GoalVerdict
GoalVerdict.description: The needed return against the windows (§7.9 (e) 2).

GoalWord.title: GoalWord
GoalWord.description:
The one word Übersicht shows beside the financial-health verdict (§7.9 (d) 5; D303
since 25 Nov 2026, „Dahinter“ and „So nicht erreichbar“ until then). Computed on read,
never stored.

GroupDifference.title: GroupDifference
GroupDifference.description:
A spending group whose month differs from its own mean over the closed months before
it (phase 10 §7.6 Haushalt (3), build decision (a)); `difference` = `amount` − `mean`.

GroupKind.title: GroupKind
GroupKind.description: movement_group.kind (D183 (2)): the thirteen shapes a transaction is classified as.

GroupPayment.title: GroupPayment
GroupPayment.description:
One confirmed allocation of a private line behind a group's month, `amount` signed as
the group's spending (money out positive, a refund negative), so a group's payments add
up to its month.

GroupStatus.title: GroupStatus
GroupStatus.description: movement_group.status: proposed -> confirmed only (the trigger group_forward).

GrundsteuerSchedule.title: GrundsteuerSchedule
GrundsteuerSchedule.description:
The Grundsteuerbescheid's schedule (phase 5 D126; §28 GrStG). tax_year on the row is the
first year it applies to, document_id the Bescheid; a later year repeats this row's dates
(same day and month) until a newer row exists. Every amount is a confirmed figure from the
Bescheid, never a model's (D13-D15).

payment_mode None = inferred (D126): `remind` until an earlier instalment was cleared by a
direct-debit line, then `sepa_mandate`. rhythm is informational (the Bescheid's wording);
the dates are what reminders use.

title.description: a short German title, two to six words naming what the document is

tax_year.description: first year the Bescheid applies to

GuideDocument.title: GuideDocument
GuideDocument.description:
One Beleg of the Belege step: a checklist item (kind = its requirement code, `item`
the row) or an owner's Lohnsteuerbescheinigung (kind wage_certificate).

GuideEstimate.title: GuideEstimate
GuideEstimate.description:
The whole-return estimate's result (phase 4b D101): positive a back-payment, negative a
refund, as GET /tax/return-estimate states it.

GuideFormResult.title: GuideFormResult
GuideFormResult.description:
One card of „Prüfen und abgeben“: the form's result as its draft states it (Anlage V:
totals.result; Anlage N: result = gross − Werbungskosten), None when no draft exists for
the year (`reason` the draft's error code).

GuidePoint.title: GuidePoint
GuidePoint.description:
One open point: a draft's to-do warning, an owner without any pay source
(`anlage_n.no_pay`), an owner whose wage-replacement benefit, announced in the
Jahresfragen, is not typed yet (`anlage_n.benefit_letter`), or a checklist gap that is a
value to type (price_split, market_rent).

HandFields.title: HandFields
HandFields.description:
The document's "Felder (von Hand)" as the typing form shows them (phase 2 D37).

For a `manual` extraction (or none) the values are its fields and all six are available.
For an AI kind, `values` holds what the reading stored for the fields that kind has a place
for (rules.hand_fields.HAND_FIELD_MAP), and `available` names exactly those; a reading the
hand types cannot hold (a low-confidence raw text in a money field) shows as null.

title.description: a short German title, two to six words naming what the document is
a short German title, two to six words naming what the document is

HausgeldabrechnungExtraction.title: HausgeldabrechnungExtraction
HausgeldabrechnungExtraction.description: Hausgeldabrechnung: the year's settlement (read by phase 3's Hausgeld rule).

Health.title: Health
Health.description:
GET /health (§13): the window, the figures, the marks, the proposals not yet
confirmed, and the to-dos.

HealthMonthView.title: HealthMonthView
HealthMonthView.description:
GET /health/months: one calendar month on read (D232, D242). `household` with its
sources; `closed` with its reasons and to-dos. `snapshot_id` names the newest stored row
of the month; `stored` is that row's month (without sources) only when it differs from
the month on read, the screen's „seit dem Abschluss geändert“ with both values. `todo`
(code month_end_missing), for a month that has ended and is closed but has no snapshot:
the first gap of its month-end read again (a missing or stale price, a balance not
reconciled to the day) with the net worth's own button, while that month-end is
incomplete; else „Monatsabschluss festhalten“ while no run holds the month-end and the
daily task would store the month the next morning.

HealthSnapshot.title: HealthSnapshot
HealthSnapshot.description:
health_snapshot row (immutable, D242). `rule_version` is the hash of rules/health/ and
rules/plan/; created_by None for the daily task.

HealthSnapshotFigures.title: HealthSnapshotFigures
HealthSnapshotFigures.description:
`health_snapshot.figures` (§5.5): the month without sources, the window's savings rate
and basis as of that month, the reserve, the debt figures and the split from the run, and
the free cash. No mark (§5.6).

HealthTodo.title: HealthTodo
HealthTodo.description: A gap as a plain to-do with the button or page that closes it (principle 7).

HiddenToken.title: HiddenToken
HiddenToken.description:
GET /wallets/{id}/hidden-tokens (D187 (3)): a token held as spam, by its asset's name
(the masked contract with the symbol the chain tells), never priced.

HoldingsExport.title: HoldingsExport
HoldingsExport.description:
A `holdings_export` row (immutable, D190) without its statement, with signed download
URLs valid a few minutes (fetch the list right before downloading).

HoldingsExportCreate.title: HoldingsExportCreate
HoldingsExportCreate.description:
POST /exports/holdings: the statement of 31 Dec of `year` for every wallet and exchange
account with a confirmed movement on or before it (D190).

HouseholdCashflow.title: HouseholdCashflow
HouseholdCashflow.description: GET /household/cashflow?month= (the Haushalt screen): confirmed allocations only.

HouseholdGoal.title: HouseholdGoal
HouseholdGoal.description: `GET /household-goal`: the card on Übersicht and the Ziel tab read the same answer.

HouseholdGroup.title: HouseholdGroup
HouseholdGroup.description:
The group a household code is shown under (mockup 10's spending groups and the
others; rules/household/taxonomy.py).

HouseholdLevers.title: HouseholdLevers
HouseholdLevers.description: `household_scenario.levers` (D248). The defaults are the spec's (§18 Q1).

HouseholdMonth.title: HouseholdMonth
HouseholdMonth.description:
§4.2. The identities between the fields are checked here; how each block is summed is
rules/health/month (step 1). `sources`: the allocation ids per field (principle 2), empty
in a stored snapshot (§5.5).

HouseholdPlanPreview.title: HouseholdPlanPreview
HouseholdPlanPreview.description:
POST /household-plan/preview (D263 (c)): the levers as typed; nothing is stored.
`scenario_id`: the row previewed (its levers replaced; what is carried from it is not
refused), else the default scenario in force.

HouseholdScenario.title: HouseholdScenario
HouseholdScenario.description: household_scenario row (append-only; §11 names its columns created_*).

HouseholdTaxContext.title: HouseholdTaxContext
HouseholdTaxContext.description:
What the assessed tax needs beyond the zvE (phase 4b D98, D109, D112), built by
household_context: the children, the Lohnersatzleistungen after the §32b Abs. 2 reduction,
church tax paid, the donations within the cap, childcare within the cap, and the §35a
credit. Without it, the assessed tax is the plain tariff (total_tax).

ImportBalance.title: ImportBalance
ImportBalance.description:
One asset of an exchange import: what the movements to its last row add up to (held)
and, once typed, what the exchange showed and whether they agree.

ImportStatus.title: ImportStatus
ImportStatus.description:
statement_import.status. `imported` with no declared closing balance is what the
inbox shows as "pending balance" (reconcile's pending_balance).

ImportStoredStatementBody.title: ImportStoredStatementBody
ImportStoredStatementBody.description: POST /documents/{id}/import-statement: the account the stored file is a statement of.

InboundDecision.title: InboundDecision
InboundDecision.description:
inbound_mail.decision (migration 0019). accepted and rejected are final at once; a
message is final after three failed rows (MAX_ATTEMPTS).

InboundMail.title: InboundMail
InboundMail.description:
GET /inbound-mail: one attempt's row with the documents and imports it produced (the
table names its timestamp recorded_at, so not Record, as TaxInput).

InboxAddress.title: InboxAddress
InboxAddress.description:
GET /inbound-mail/address (§11, Einstellungen › Posteingang-Adresse): the token
address to forward to and the label the app reads, both null while email-in is not set
up (the four HAUSBUCH_INBOX_* values, §5.2). The IMAP login and the app password never
leave the server.

InboxItem.title: InboxItem
InboxItem.description:
One thing to act on, with a one-line reasoning and one question. Exactly the ids its
action endpoint needs are set.

InboxLines.title: InboxLines
InboxLines.description:
GET /inbox/lines (phase 10 §7.3 (5)): the bank lines and statement imports Zu prüfen's
cards look up, instead of every account's lines and imports. `transactions`: each inbox
item's line and both lines of every possible duplicate; `imports`: each item's statement
import and those duplicate lines' imports. Each serialised exactly as
GET /accounts/{id}/transactions and /imports serialise it.

IncomeChangeNote.title: IncomeChangeNote
IncomeChangeNote.description: A code, never a sentence (§12), as phase 4b stores questionnaire answers.

IncomeInput.title: IncomeInput
IncomeInput.description: API read model (the table names its timestamp recorded_at, so not Record).

IncomeInputCreate.title: IncomeInputCreate
IncomeInputCreate.description:
One income input row as written. A correction is a new row with supersedes_id (a
current row of the same kind, year and owner); withdrawn = true ends a row without
replacing it (its value repeats the withdrawn row's). Rows are never changed.

title.description: a short German title, two to six words naming what the document is

tax_year.description: the year assessed (Bescheid für 20xx über Einkommensteuer ...)

taxable_income.description: zu versteuerndes Einkommen (not Summe der Einkünfte, Gesamtbetrag der Einkünfte or Einkommen)

assessment_type.description: the kind of assessment, e.g. Zusammenveranlagung or Einzelveranlagung

addressee.description: the names of the persons the Bescheid is for, names only

IncomeTaxAssessmentExtraction.title: IncomeTaxAssessmentExtraction
IncomeTaxAssessmentExtraction.description:
Einkommensteuerbescheid (bescheid / einkommensteuerbescheid; phase-4b.md D129, §8.4):
the assessed zvE of one year, proposed as the household's bescheid_zve. Only these fields:
no identifier, no address, no other figure of the assessment is ever read.

InitialRent.title: InitialRent
InitialRent.description: The first rent row, recorded with the tenancy (reason 'initial').

InvestmentSplit.title: InvestmentSplit
InvestmentSplit.description:
Phase 10 §7.11 (a) 2, D301: the share of the money invested that goes to funds and
securities (`depot`) and to crypto, each a percent with one place, adding up to exactly
100. The household's own lever; the form is only prefilled from its purchases (§7.11 (f))
and the app proposes no split (D247).

Invite.title: Invite
Invite.description:
A pending enrollment invite. enrollment_url is set only in the POST /auth/invites
response, the one time the raw token exists; GET /auth/invites never has it.

InviteCreate.title: InviteCreate
InviteCreate.description: POST /auth/invites: a household member to invite (creates their app_user row).

title.description: a short German title, two to six words naming what the document is

sender.description: name of who issued it, without the address: decides the cost kind

subject.description: what it is for, as written (Betreff / Gegenstand)

cost_lines.description: every cost line of the bill, each written `text | amount | code`: the line's text and its amount as printed, then the code of the kind of cost it is, the only part you choose yourself, one of acquisition_cost, loan_fees, repairs, renovation, insurance, grundsteuer, property_management, hausgeld_umlagefaehig, hausgeld_verwaltung, electricity, professional_fees, bank_fees, other_expense, vat (acquisition_cost for the purchase and its land register entry, loan_fees for a Grundschuld or loan, vat for the Umsatzsteuer line); never a subtotal (Netto, Zwischensumme) or the total

InvoiceExtraction.title: InvoiceExtraction
InvoiceExtraction.description: Invoices: Nebenkosten (notary, Grundbuchamt, broker) now, repairs and others later.

LearnedExchangeAddress.title: LearnedExchangeAddress
LearnedExchangeAddress.description:
D261: what a person's link taught about the exchange, as its page lists it with
„Vergessen“: a deposit address on a chain (masked, never in clear, D179), or an own wallet
address its withdrawals arrive on (`wallet_label` names the wallet).

title.description: a short German title, two to six words naming what the document is

unit_label.description: the let unit's label: for a single room let on its own the room (e.g. Zimmer 3), not the flat's floor or number; else the flat's label (e.g. WE 3)

signed_on.description: Vertragsdatum: when it was signed, often only as 'Ort, den <Datum>' by the signatures

operating_costs_prepayment.description: the monthly Nebenkosten besides the Kaltmiete: the Betriebskostenvorauszahlung, or a Nebenkostenpauschale (also one that includes Heizung, Warmwasser or Strom)

heating_costs_prepayment.description: Heizkostenvorauszahlung, only when the lease states it as its own amount

operating_costs_clause.description: the sentence(s) on how the Neben- or Betriebskosten are paid, as printed: a Vorauszahlung that is abgerechnet each year, a Pauschale with no Abrechnung (also 'eine gesonderte Abrechnung erfolgt nicht'), or one Inklusiv- or Warmmiete that includes them

rent_due_clause.description: when the monthly rent is due, as printed (e.g. 'spätestens am dritten Werktag eines jeden Monats', 'im Voraus zum 1. eines Monats')

LeaseExtraction.title: LeaseExtraction
LeaseExtraction.description: Mietvertrag (contract / lease). Step 2, gated by ai_tenant_documents (D16).

LetterReason.title: LetterReason
LetterReason.description:
One Betriebskosten category in the letter's reason (§560 Abs. 1 S. 2 BGB: named and
explained): the flat's monthly cost when the Pauschale was set and now, each with the
allocations or tax input it came from (the service looks up their documents). Electricity
is never a reason (D155 (3)).

Levers.title: Levers
Levers.description: What the user sets for a projection (D87). Defaults are the spec's (Q4, Luis).

Light.title: Light
Light.description:
One figure's mark: the colour (None: unmarked), the limits used with their origins, and
the codes of its sentences (§5.6). Computed on read, never stored.

LinkTarget.title: LinkTarget
LinkTarget.description: What a document can be linked to (document_link has one FK column per target).

LinkTargetRef.title: LinkTargetRef
LinkTargetRef.description: One entity a document is linked to (a document_link row without its own id).

title.description: a short German title, two to six words naming what the document is

contract_number.description: Darlehensnummer / Vertragsnummer; when none is printed, the loan's Kontonummer. The number only, without its label

follow_up_rate.description: Sollzins p.a. after the Sollzinsbindung ends, if stated: an agreed Anschlusszins, or the variable Sollzins the loan continues at (e.g. 'Der veränderliche Sollzinssatz beträgt derzeit ...'); never the Mindestzins, never the effektiver Jahreszins

interest_only_clause.description: the sentence saying that until Tilgungsbeginn, or until the first full Rate, only interest (Sollzinsen) is paid, as written, if the contract has one

signed_on.description: Vertragsdatum: when it was signed, often only as 'Ort, den <Datum>' by the signatures; when the parties signed on different dates, the latest of them

LoanCreateRequest.title: LoanCreateRequest
LoanCreateRequest.description: POST /loans: LoanCreate plus the contract date (create_loan's signed_on).

LoanSummary.title: LoanSummary
LoanSummary.description:
GET /loans/{id}/summary (phase 10, mockup 25): the loan page's two figures the stored
terms do not state. balance_today: what is owed on balance_on (today, Berlin time) by the
schedule of the stored terms, rules.net_worth.loan_balance as the net worth reads it; None
before the payout (balance_on < disbursed_on). initial_repayment_rate: the anfängliche
Tilgung, rules.loan_schedule.initial_repayment_rate; None outside a Rate's range.

LoanTerms.title: LoanTerms
LoanTerms.description: Everything the schedule is computed from. Input to rules.loan_schedule.

Lot.title: Lot
Lot.description:
A lot, computed on read (D188 (1)). `id` is derived from its origin (the creating
movement, or a moved part's origin and link), so a re-read gives the same id; `movement_id`
is the movement that created it, kept through every move (principle 2: a lot links to its
movements); `acquired_at` is the instant, FIFO's second key after `acquired_on`. Folded in
from rules/lots.HeldLot in step 6.

LotPriceNeed.title: LotPriceNeed
LotPriceNeed.description: „Kurs eintragen“ for this coin and day prices the lot (a typed `user` price, D167).

title.description: a short German title, two to six words naming what the document is

manager.description: the Verwalter's name only, without the address

house_number.description: house number of the managed property

postal_code.description: five-digit PLZ of the managed property

monthly_fee.description: the Verwaltervergütung per month as written, e.g. 30,00 € zzgl. MwSt. je Einheit

fee_net.description: the Verwaltervergütung per month as a number, as the contract states it, before any MwSt. the contract adds

amount_total.description: Betrag: the monthly fee with MwSt.

ManagementContractExtraction.title: ManagementContractExtraction
ManagementContractExtraction.description:
Verwaltervertrag (contract / management_contract, D130): a Mietverwaltungsvertrag with
the household's letting manager, or the WEG's Verwaltervertrag. Proposes typing and
link:property; the fee is booked from the bank lines that pay it, never from here.

ManualDocumentFields.title: ManualDocumentFields
ManualDocumentFields.description: The fields a person types in phase 1. Per-type schemas replace this in phase 2.

MarkedFigure.title: MarkedFigure
MarkedFigure.description: The figures a mark may be put on. The split's shares are not among them (D240).

MarketRent.title: MarketRent
MarketRent.description: The Mietspiegel's net cold rent per m² (D61); the running costs come from the ledger.

Me.title: Me
Me.description: GET /auth/me, and the response of a successful sign-in or enrollment.

Member.title: Member
Member.description:
GET /auth/members: one household member (an app_user of the workspace). has_passkey
is false while an invited member has not enrolled yet. Never a passkey or a session.

MissingItem.title: MissingItem
MissingItem.description:
Something the estimate still waits for: an open question slot, a document, or a
benefit letter answered "yes, pending".

MonthDifferences.title: MonthDifferences
MonthDifferences.description:
The newest closed month (`month`) against the mean of the closed months before it
(`baseline`, three to twelve, oldest first): at most three groups, the largest difference
first; empty when none crosses both thresholds. Figures only: no colour, no advice.

MovableAfaLine.title: MovableAfaLine
MovableAfaLine.description:
wk.afa_movable for one asset and tax year (D80): linear over useful_life_years from the
AfA start month of from_year (§7 Abs. 1 EStG), pro rata by the months owned; the last year
takes the rest, then 0.00.

basis = amount × (price + Σ cost rows) ÷ price when in_purchase_price (its share of the
Nebenkosten goes with it), else amount. book_value_start is the basis less the AfA of
earlier years; remaining_months the months of the life left at the start of the year.

MovableAsset.title: MovableAsset
MovableAsset.description:
A movable asset with its own AfA (D80; BFH IX R 14/15: a fitted kitchen is not part of
the building). tax_year on the row is its first year (the purchase year when it came with
the flat); document_id is optional (the estimate's evidence, e.g. a planner printout).

amount is its share of the purchase price, gross (or its own price when bought separately).
in_purchase_price: bought with the flat, so its basis (amount plus its share of the
Nebenkosten) leaves the building's AfA basis, never the land's.

MovedPayment.title: MovedPayment
MovedPayment.description: A payment booked in the draft's year that §5.1 counts in another year (or vice versa).

MovementAnswered.title: MovementAnswered
MovementAnswered.description: POST /movements/{id}/answer: the movement that now stands for the answered one.

MovementImport.title: MovementImport
MovementImport.description:
movement_import row: the statement_import of an exchange export (D166). status reuses
ImportStatus's four values (imported = waiting for the typed balances).

MovementImportFormat.title: MovementImportFormat
MovementImportFormat.description:
movement_import.format (migration 0025; binance_csv since 0028; chain_sync since
0041, one wallet sync's stored original, D182 (3)).

MovementKind.title: MovementKind
MovementKind.description:
asset_movement.kind (migration 0025, §8). Phase 7 widens the CHECK with the chain
kinds of the design's §2.2.

MovementSource.title: MovementSource
MovementSource.description: asset_movement.source: where the row was read from.

MovementStatus.title: MovementStatus
MovementStatus.description:
asset_movement.status: only proposed -> confirmed moves (the trigger of 0025); a
correction is a new row and the old one's superseded_by.

NameCategoryCount.title: NameCategoryCount
NameCategoryCount.description: How many earlier lines of the payee are confirmed under one category (phase 6 D160).

NetWorth.title: NetWorth
NetWorth.description:
GET /net-worth?on=: NetWorth(on) of D167 (4) on read, or a stored month-end (`run`
set). `by_owner` covers what has shares: an account or a property without shares
counts in its class and the total, in no owner, and is listed in `unassigned`.
`property_net` is the properties' estimate less their loans (mockup 07's „Immobilie
(netto)“); before a property's handover its part is the price paid so far less what its
