loans paid out (D265), and `property_estimate` holds that paid price. The class
`liabilities` holds the loans and a credit card's balance.

NetWorthLine.title: NetWorthLine
NetWorthLine.description:
One figure of the net worth, asset by asset (D172: the month-end is compared with the
household's spreadsheet line by line). `value_eur` None: not valued, counted nowhere,
`not_valued_reason` says why. A balance's `as_of` is the last day a reconciled statement
covers (D167 (4)); a position's price has its own day. `estimate`: the property's value
and a loan's balance from the handover on, both labelled as estimates on the screen;
before the handover the price paid so far and the loan's payouts are booked figures,
not estimates (D265).

NetWorthOverview.title: NetWorthOverview
NetWorthOverview.description:
GET /net-worth/overview: the Übersicht's card. `today` on read; `month_end` the latest
stored month-end, None before the first; `month_end_due` the last month-end when no run
holds it yet (the button „Monatsabschluss festhalten“); `month_end_now` the total read
now for the stored month-end's day when it differs from the stored total, set only when
that day is the last month-end (the one the button stores again).

NetWorthPoint.title: NetWorthPoint
NetWorthPoint.description:
One month-end of the series (D241, §5.4). A month-end without a stored run is a gap:
no run, no figures, and the to-do „Monatsabschluss festhalten“.

NetWorthProjection.title: NetWorthProjection
NetWorthProjection.description: §7.5. Instead of the points, the to-dos when an input is missing (§7.5 (1)).

NetWorthRun.title: NetWorthRun
NetWorthRun.description: One stored month-end: the valuation_snapshot rows of one net_worth_run_id.

NetWorthTodo.title: NetWorthTodo
NetWorthTodo.description:
A gap in the figure as a plain to-do with the button or page that closes it
(principle 7).

NextTranche.title: NextTranche
NextTranche.description:
„Nächste Tranche steuerfrei“: the earliest future `tax_free_from` over every open lot,
with the units of every coin that becomes free that day (D188 (5)).

NoPayFact.title: NoPayFact
NoPayFact.description:
„Kein Arbeitslohn in <Jahr>“ (D195): the owner had no pay that year (e.g. a whole year of
parental leave). The row is the statement; its value carries nothing.

NoRateReason.title: NoRateReason
NoRateReason.description: Why a portfolio shows no yearly return (rules.performance.portfolio.NoRate).

NotInvested.title: NotInvested
NotInvested.description:
§7.11 (a) 6, „noch nicht angelegt“: once a split is saved, the amount by which the
window's purchases fall short of it. A fact only: no reminder, no email, no colour. In
`generic` mode (D251) `lines` is empty and only the amount is named.

NotInvestedLine.title: NotInvestedLine
NotInvestedLine.description:
One kind whose purchases over the window stayed below its saved share (§7.11 (a) 6):
`amount` = the share of everything invested less what was bought in it.

OneOff.title: OneOff
OneOff.description:
A one-off in `month`. §7.3 amended (PR #434 review D): a one-off in a month at or
before the newest closed month may stay in a scenario row; the plan ignores it, since the
measured months already hold it. Only a month after the horizon's end is refused.

OneOffCode.title: OneOffCode
OneOffCode.description:
One row of „Was als einmalig zählt“ (GET /household/one-off-codes, phase 10 §7.12 (a),
D307): a code the household may switch, whether the taxonomy counts it as one-off
(`default`) and whether it does under the default scenario's switches (`one_off`), and what
was paid in it in the calendar year `year` up to today (the confirmed private lines of
money out, the household month's codes), positive.

OneOffCodes.title: OneOffCodes
OneOffCodes.description:
GET /household/one-off-codes: the one-off codes first (each listed, also at 0), then
every other switchable code with a payment this year, the largest sum first.

OneOffMarkRequest.title: OneOffMarkRequest
OneOffMarkRequest.description: POST /household/one-off-marks: a person's answer on one confirmed private payment.

OpenReturn.title: OpenReturn
OpenReturn.description:
D162 amended (7), 15 Nov 2026: a credit on a private account that returns an earlier
debit of the same account (rules.household.returns), with the debits it may return: one
when the rule found one, several when it cannot tell which (never guessed). Booked by
POST /returns (ReturnedPaymentCreate).

OpenTransfer.title: OpenTransfer
OpenTransfer.description:
One leg waiting for its counterpart, with the legs it may be linked to.

own_wallets (D181 (c) amended 16 Nov 2026): on a transfer.unmatched_leg card of an
exchange's withdrawal to a balance-only chain that no hash can prove (none in the export,
or the node did not know it a day later), the own addresses on that chain it may be
booked to (POST /transfers/own-wallet-deposit). paired_address_id: the one address the
exchange's withdrawals are learned to arrive on; the app links them itself once the
address's last read balance covers them, so this one waits because it does not yet.
paired_addresses: how many own addresses on that chain the exchange's withdrawals are
learned to arrive on; above one the app cannot tell which this one paid, so it links none
by itself and the person picks (review of 16 Nov 2026).

history_todo: on an unmatched withdrawal of an exchange whose withdrawals its withdrawal
history completes (Binance), the exchange page's to-do (exchange.withdrawal_history_missing
or exchange.withdrawal_history_no_match, D178 (4)): its transaction export lists the gross
amount with no fee, network or hash, so nothing is offered until the history completed it
(review of 16 Nov 2026).

OpenTransferCode.title: OpenTransferCode
OpenTransferCode.description:
GET /transfers/open: why a leg waits for a person (D162). proposed: a counterpart
fits but no link was written (a leg without an own IBAN, or one booked before the
other).

OperatingCostsTerms.title: OperatingCostsTerms
OperatingCostsTerms.description: How a lease agrees the running costs (tenancy.operating_costs_terms, 0013; phase 3 D72).

OverviewPosition.title: OverviewPosition
OverviewPosition.description:
One asset on one account: units from the confirmed movements to `on`, the price
`rules.valuation.price_on` chose, and the value; `not_valued_reason` says why there is
none (valuation.not_valued past the last reconciled date, price.no_source). `from_report`
marks a price taken from a depot report (source statement) on a fund whose issuer has no
adapter: „Kurs aus dem letzten Bericht“ (D174 (4)).

OwnWalletChoice.title: OwnWalletChoice
OwnWalletChoice.description:
D181 (c) amended 16 Nov 2026: an own address on a balance-only chain (BNB Smart Chain)
an exchange's withdrawal may be booked to by hand, „An eigene Wallet: <Wallet> (<Chain>)“.
The masked address only (D179).

OwnWalletDepositCreate.title: OwnWalletDepositCreate
OwnWalletDepositCreate.description:
POST /transfers/own-wallet-deposit (D181 (c) amended 16 Nov 2026): book an exchange's
withdrawal to an own address on a balance-only chain. The app writes the deposit (the
withdrawal less its fee, on its date), links it (matched_by user) and confirms both legs;
remember_withdrawal_pair (ticked by default) learns the pair (exchange, address), so the
next such withdrawals are linked by code while the address's balance covers them.

OwnerGain.title: OwnerGain
OwnerGain.description:
One spouse's share of a §23 gain, tested against the Freigrenze of the sale year's rule
set (`speculation_freigrenze`, D93; a cliff).

OwnerZve.title: OwnerZve
OwnerZve.description:
One owner's part of the estimate (D84). deductions = the default, the override, or (phase
4b D98) the Anlage N's applied Werbungskosten + Vorsorge + 36. gross_source says where the
gross came from: the expected_gross_pay row, or a certificate or the payslip projection, or
declared_none when the owner said „Kein Arbeitslohn“ for the year (phase 4b D195: gross 0).

Passkey.title: Passkey
Passkey.description: GET /auth/passkeys: one passkey of the signed-in user.

PasskeyVerifyRequest.title: PasskeyVerifyRequest
PasskeyVerifyRequest.description: POST /auth/passkeys/verify: a further passkey for the signed-in user.

Path.title: Path
Path.description: D246, §7.2. None: not within the horizon.

PathLater.title: PathLater
PathLater.description: One path's amount to the reserve per month from `FlatChange.month` on.

PaybackYear.title: PaybackYear
PaybackYear.description:
One year of the payback series: phase 4's net cash after tax of an actual year (the
current one so far) or a projected year of the default scenario, and the running sum from
the purchase year.

PaymentIbanConfirmed.title: PaymentIbanConfirmed
PaymentIbanConfirmed.description:
POST /accounts/{id}/payment-iban (D176 (4)): the card account, and how many learned
rules on the confirmed IBAN were switched off by it (a payment to the card is a transfer
now, so a rule booking it as spending would pre-empt the transfer matcher).

PaymentIbanProposal.title: PaymentIbanProposal
PaymentIbanProposal.description:
The payment IBAN a card statement prints (D176 (4)), masked; POST
/accounts/{id}/payment-iban with its import_id confirms it.

PaymentOneOff.title: PaymentOneOff
PaymentOneOff.description:
GET /household/one-off-marks?transaction_id= (phase 10 §7.12 (b), D307): one part of a
private payment that „Als einmalig markieren“ may mark, as of today (the parts POST
/household/one-off-marks accepts; a payment with none gets no button). `marked`: its newest
answer is `one_off`; `category_one_off`: its code counts as one-off under the default
scenario's switches, so it counts as one-off whatever its own answer and the panel shows
no button. What was paid, positive.

PaymentProofBody.title: PaymentProofBody
PaymentProofBody.description:
Phase 3 D149: the bill an existing payment proof pays (the to-do's „Vorhandenen
Nachweis zuordnen“).

title.description: a short German title, two to six words naming what the document is

paid_on.description: the day the payment was made: Ausführungsdatum, Buchungstag or Wertstellung of the transfer

amount.description: the amount transferred, as stated; never a balance, a limit or a fee

payee.description: the payee (Empfänger, Zahlungsempfänger) only; never the payer, the account holder or any other person

purpose.description: the Verwendungszweck as stated, without any account details

PaymentProofExtraction.title: PaymentProofExtraction
PaymentProofExtraction.description:
Zahlungsnachweis (other / payment_proof; phase-3.md D143): the proof that a bill was
paid, uploaded from the bill's to-do. Only these fields, besides the title and date every
reading carries: no IBAN, no account number and no name but the payee is ever asked for,
and the quotes are scrubbed of identifiers (jobs.document_read).

Payslip.title: Payslip
Payslip.description:
One month's payslip of one employer (D105). months_remaining_paid defaults to
12 − month in the review; fewer when pay stops before December.

title.description: a short German title, two to six words naming what the document is

employee_name.description: the employee's name, to match the owner

period_month.description: the month paid, as its first day

PayslipExtraction.title: PayslipExtraction
PayslipExtraction.description:
Gehaltsabrechnung: one month, with the month column and the year-to-date column
(Jahreswerte / kumuliert). Net pay and the bank account are not read.

PlanAssumptions.title: PlanAssumptions
PlanAssumptions.description: Card 4 „Eure Annahmen“: nothing the app chose.

PlanExplanation.title: PlanExplanation
PlanExplanation.description:
GET /household-plan/explanation (§8.6): rendered from its own stored facts, with
`stale` when today's facts differ from them. With no row stored for the scenario and mode,
the template text rendered on read from today's facts: `id` and `created_at` are null,
`stale` is false, and `reason` is `consent_off` while ai_private_accounts is off (no
request is built then, D253), else null (none requested yet). A stored model text the
current validator no longer passes is shown as the template of its stored facts: the
row's `id`, status `template`, reason `rejected`.

PlanExplanationQueued.title: PlanExplanationQueued
PlanExplanationQueued.description:
POST /household-plan/explanation, 202: whether explain_plan was queued. Never while
ai_private_accounts is off (D253): the template text is then rendered on read.

PlanExplanationRequest.title: PlanExplanationRequest
PlanExplanationRequest.description: POST /household-plan/explanation („Neu erklären“): the scenario, else the default.

PlanGoalCard.title: PlanGoalCard
PlanGoalCard.description: Card 1, the green goal card of 19f: target, month, word and the share reached.

PlanHeute.title: PlanHeute
PlanHeute.description:
Card 2 „Heute“: the net worth, the reserve in months of its need (D305) and the mean saved
per month of the window; the reserve's accounts (D304) with their provider, „Für euch“ or
with the switch `accounts` only.

PlanIncomeGap.title: PlanIncomeGap
PlanIncomeGap.description:
„Einkommenslücke“: months with no income, the reserve paying first, then the invested
money (`drawn`); `used_up` when even that is short.

PlanMonth.title: PlanMonth
PlanMonth.description:
One future month of §7.1; `spending_delta` is §7.6 (3)'s Δ(k), Σ (planned − mean) over
the spending changes in force, already inside `free`.

PlanOtherRoutes.title: PlanOtherRoutes
PlanOtherRoutes.description:
Card 6 „Andere Wege“: routes 2, 3 and 4 of §7.11 (c), one figure each; route 3's history
(windows reached, verdict) for its panel.

PlanOverride.title: PlanOverride
PlanOverride.description: Sets a detected plan's monthly amount, or drops it (D245).

PlanPage.title: PlanPage
PlanPage.description:
`GET /household-goal/plan`. `goal` None while no goal is set (word `none`); the other
cards None while the goal has no word (`issue` says why, `todos` what is missing). In the
shared view `risks` or `assumptions` are absent when their switch is off, and the to-dos
always.

PlanPropertyAssumption.title: PlanPropertyAssumption
PlanPropertyAssumption.description:
A property in the walk: kept (D301 (a) 5) or sold in its scenario's year, and its
scenario's yearly value change. `kind` names it generically („Wohnung“); `label` only „Für
euch“, since a property's label can be its address.

PlanRates.title: PlanRates
PlanRates.description: The yearly rates the route walks (typed by the household, D247; the reserve's D304).

PlanRepair.title: PlanRepair
PlanRepair.description: „Große Reparatur“: living area × the year's maintenance rate × `years`, paid once.

PlanRisks.title: PlanRisks
PlanRisks.description:
Card 5 „Wenn es schlechter läuft“: the route run again under three changes, each the
months it moves the goal. The to-dos (a property's living area) never in the shared view.

PlanRoute.title: PlanRoute
PlanRoute.description:
Card 3 „Der Plan“, the main route (D303, „Ausgewogener Weg“): the extra invested per
month and its split by class, the wants' cut and the month reached; „auf Kurs“ without
moves. `without_route` the value at the due month without change, `gap` the target less it.

PlanSource.title: PlanSource
PlanSource.description: A source of a size in risks.yaml (the maintenance rate).

PlanSwitches.title: PlanSwitches
PlanSwitches.description: „Was geteilt wird“ (D306): the five switches the shared view was built with.

PlanThisMonth.title: PlanThisMonth
PlanThisMonth.description: Card 7 „Diesen Monat“: the route's steps for the running month, at most two.

PlanWant.title: PlanWant
PlanWant.description: A want the route lowers: its measured mean (`from`) and its budget on the route (`to`).

PlanWeakMarkets.title: PlanWeakMarkets
PlanWeakMarkets.description:
„Schwache Märkte“: per kind the worst window of the goal's years in its own history
(`worst`), walked never above the typed rate (`rates`, `capped`).

PlayedChange.title: PlayedChange
PlayedChange.description:
One change of the levers with what it plans (§7.6 (3)): `planned` per month while it is
in force, `delta` = planned − the code's mean.

PortfolioFigures.title: PortfolioFigures
PortfolioFigures.description:
Gain since the start = value + taken out − paid in; `gain_ratio` = gain ÷ paid in;
`yearly_return` the money-weighted return (xirr), None for less than a year of history
(`no_rate`). Every figure None (but the value) when a payment's euros are unknown
(`unpriced_flows`) or a position held today has no value (`unvalued_positions`, the value
then leaving it out); a total is None when one of its portfolios is.

PortfolioFlow.title: PortfolioFlow
PortfolioFlow.description: One payment in (+) or out (−) of a portfolio, with the rows it was read from.

PortfolioFlowKind.title: PortfolioFlowKind
PortfolioFlowKind.description: What a payment in or out of a portfolio is (decision (b)).

PositionHoldings.title: PositionHoldings
PositionHoldings.description:
An account's position in one asset at the end of the statement's day. `symbol` and
`name` label it (a chain token's symbol is a label, D180 amended); `price_eur` and
`price_on` the price `value_eur` used (phase 6 D167's `price_on`, a chain token through
its `priced_as` asset); `reconciled` is false when the last sync on or before the day of an
address holding it did not reconcile (an exchange has no sync: true).

PossibleDuplicate.title: PossibleDuplicate
PossibleDuplicate.description:
transaction_id was stored first; other_transaction_id is the later-imported line,
the one `merged` excludes.

PriceLabel.title: PriceLabel
PriceLabel.description: Where a shown price comes from, in the screen's words (D174 (4)).

PriceRenovation.title: PriceRenovation
PriceRenovation.description:
Phase 3 D287 (Q-O180, Luis 23 Nov 2026): the Kaufvertrag obliges the seller to renovate
the flat after the handover, paid inside the price; the household claims that part as its
own renovation, openly (BFH IX R 34/03 points the other way, so the Finanzamt may refuse).

While `claimed` (or `accepted`, after the Finanzamt's assessment said yes) the gross
`amount` leaves the building's share of the AfA basis (never the land's), counts in the
15 % test at `amount_net` as work done on `period_end` (D76), and within the limit is
Erhaltungsaufwand in the year of `paid_on` (§11 EStG, the day the price was paid). Over the
limit it returns to the basis (limit_exceeded). `declined` (the Finanzamt's „Nein“) and no
row leave the draft exactly as without the claim.

document_id on the row is the Kaufvertrag; `clause` quotes its renovation clause (free text:
it stays in the row and never enters the event payload). The row has no tax_year.

PriceSourceKind.title: PriceSourceKind
PriceSourceKind.description:
price.source (migration 0025). Named ...Kind because §11's PriceSource is the fetcher
protocol below. The precedence among one day's rows is rules.valuation's data.

PriceSplitCreate.title: PriceSplitCreate
PriceSplitCreate.description: One candidate building/land split. Rows are append-only; the property selects one.

PriceSplitSource.title: PriceSplitSource
PriceSplitSource.description: Where the building/land split of the purchase price comes from.

PrivateCostValue.title: PrivateCostValue
PrivateCostValue.description:
A rental cost paid from a private account (phase 4b D111): trips to the flat, postage,
a landlords' association, software and the like; tax_year on the row is the year paid.
travel: trips × km_round_trip × the rule set's travel_rate_per_km (no amount typed);
every other class: amount × share. financing (phase 4b D134) is a Geldbeschaffungskosten
bill paid privately, such as the notary and land registry for the Grundschuld: it goes to
wk.financing_costs, every other class to wk.other. Phase 2 D135: a cost a bill's reading
proposes carries its `category` (PRIVATE_COST_CATEGORIES, with class other, or financing
for loan_fees); the draft then books it on that category's line of the rule set's
category_lines, as a confirmed allocation of the category would land. The label is free
text: it stays in the row and never enters the event payload (only amounts and codes do).

Phase 3 D137: a row whose category the 15 % test counts (LIMIT_15_CATEGORIES) may carry
performed_on (when the work was done, the date tested against the window, D76) and
amount_net (the bill's net for this part, before share; at most amount); a row without
them is counted conservatively. Other rows carry neither.

ProgressionInfo.title: ProgressionInfo
ProgressionInfo.description:
§32b (D102): the special rate is income_tax(zvE + L) ÷ (zvE + L), truncated to four
decimals of the percentage (six of the fraction, H 32b EStH 2025 Fall B: 6,8648 %), and
applied to the zvE with the tax floored to whole euros.

ProjectionAssumption.title: ProjectionAssumption
ProjectionAssumption.description: What was assumed, by which scenario row (§7.5 (9)).

ProjectionChange.title: ProjectionChange
ProjectionChange.description: The change since the start in five rows that sum to it (§7.5 (7)).

ProjectionPoint.title: ProjectionPoint
ProjectionPoint.description: One 31 December (or the start): the classes, the liabilities, the total.

PropertiesPaidIn.title: PropertiesPaidIn
PropertiesPaidIn.description:
GET /properties/equity: every property of the workspace (by label) and total_paid_in,
Σ paid_in over the properties that have one (0.00 without any).

PropertiesPayback.title: PropertiesPayback
PropertiesPayback.description:
GET /properties/payback: every property of the workspace (by label), and the totals over
those with a payback (reason None): paid_in, cash_back, percent (None when paid_in ≤ 0 or
none counts), profit_today, and break_even_year, the first year whose running sum over
those properties (each held at its last year after it) reaches their paid_in, None when
not by sale_year, the latest of their sale years; both None when one of them has no
projection (projection_error_code). The years lists are the union.

PropertyOwnership.title: PropertyOwnership
PropertyOwnership.description: Shares per property must sum to exactly 1 (service-layer rule, see fixtures).

PropertyPaidIn.title: PropertyPaidIn
PropertyPaidIn.description:
One property's own money put in (rules.property_equity.paid_in): purchase_price +
acquisition_costs (Σ the Nebenkosten rows, the sum the AfA basis adds) + own_loan_costs
(the private_cost rows of class financing in force, every tax year, amount × share)
− loan_principal (Σ the property's loans' principal). Signed: a loan above price and
costs gives a negative paid_in, served as it is. paid_in None, with `reason`, when the
property is left out of the total: no purchase price, or ownership ended by today (as
the net worth leaves a sold property out).

PropertyPatch.title: PropertyPatch
PropertyPatch.description: Non-milestone fields only: the purchase dates and price change through corrections.

PropertyPayback.title: PropertyPayback
PropertyPayback.description:
One property's way back to its own money put in. cash_back: Σ phase 4's actual years'
net cash after tax (rent in + other income + Umlagen in − cash paid out, the loan's
Tilgung included − the tax effect), purchase year through today's. percent = cash_back ÷
paid_in, None when paid_in ≤ 0. break_even_year: the first year whose running sum of the
actual and then the default scenario's projected net cash reaches paid_in; None when not
by `sale_year`, the projection's last year. tax_estimated_years: actual years whose tax
effect is an estimate (no Bescheid yet); income_missing_years: actual years without any
income input, whose tax effect is not counted. Everything after paid_in is None with a
`reason` when it cannot be computed. projection_error_code: the default scenario's
projection raised a rule error (scenario.sale_year_before_today when its sale year is not
after today's, or no rule set or tariff): only the projected years, break_even_year and
sale_year are then missing; the cash back, its percent and the sale today stay.

Proposal.title: Proposal
Proposal.description:
Read shape. kind is null until the document is classified (the row is created
`queued` at upload); records is empty until `ready`, and again after the D19 scrub.

ProposalApplyResult.title: ProposalApplyResult
ProposalApplyResult.description: POST /proposals/{id}/apply: the applied proposal and what each record became.

ProposalRecord.title: ProposalRecord
ProposalRecord.description:
One record the proposal would create or patch.

key: "property", "unit", "cost:notary", "loan", "tenant:1", "tenancy", "rent", "typing",
  "price_split", "ownership", "link:property", "correction:notarized_on", ...
fields: by the *Create / *Patch field name; a nested field is dotted ("address.city").
  Values the apply step supplies itself (the document as Beleg or evidence, the ids of
  records created in the same apply, a split's source) are not fields.
current: the existing record's values of the same fields, when target_id is set.

ProposalRerunBody.title: ProposalRerunBody
ProposalRerunBody.description:
POST /documents/{id}/proposals (optional body): read the document again. The
tenant-data flag is copied from the document's latest proposal; true adds it, false
never removes it (D16).

ProposalStatus.title: ProposalStatus
ProposalStatus.description: proposal.status (§3.1). applied and rejected are decisions; the rest are job states.

ProposalTargetMode.title: ProposalTargetMode
ProposalTargetMode.description: proposal.target_mode: whether the proposal creates new records or patches `targets`.

ProposedOneOff.title: ProposedOneOff
ProposedOneOff.description:
Phase 4b's expected refund (positive) or back-payment (negative) of one tax year, from
the whole-return estimate of Steuern › Gesamt, proposed without a month (Q-O168, answered
by mockup 12): a member picks the month the money is expected, and „Übernehmen“ adds it to
the levers as `OneOff(source="return_estimate:<tax_year>")`. Until then the plan counts
no refund.

title.description: a short German title, two to six words naming what the document is

purchase_date.description: Übergang von Besitz, Nutzen und Lasten

land_value.description: price share allocated to the land, if stated

unit_label.description: WE Nr. as in the Teilungserklärung, e.g. WE 3

renovation_clause.description: the sentence obliging the seller to renovate or refurbish the flat after the handover, paid with the Kaufpreis, as written, if the contract has one

renovation_amount.description: the part of the Kaufpreis for that renovation as printed (brutto, incl. USt.), if stated

renovation_amount_net.description: that renovation's net amount (netto, without USt.), only if printed

renovation_vat_rate.description: the Umsatzsteuer rate the contract states for that renovation, if stated

renovation_start.description: the date that renovation begins, only if printed as a date

renovation_end.description: the date that renovation is to be finished, only if printed as a date

PurchaseSummary.title: PurchaseSummary
PurchaseSummary.description:
GET /properties/{id}/purchase-summary (phase 10, mockup 25): the Nebenkosten's Summe and
the AfA line of the selected split, both from the facts the Anlage V draft reads, so they
cannot drift from it. acquisition_costs_total is Σ the cost rows the basis adds to the
price (rules.tax.afa.cost_rows_total), served with or without a split. afa is the draft's
wk.afa line for afa.tax_year: the property's last available year (today's, the purchase
year if later, the year ownership ended if earlier) or, without a rule set for it, the
latest earlier one that has one; None when no such year has a rule set. afa.basis None:
no split selected.

QuestionTarget.title: QuestionTarget
QuestionTarget.description:
What a "yes" leads to: rows of a return_input or tax_input kind, or a reminder printed on
the Gesamt card and the sheet. value_match selects the target rows by their value's coded
fields (e.g. {"item_class": "subscription"}, {"expense_class": "account_fee"}), so two
questions can share one kind (spec §7 addition, 10 Nov 2026).

QuestionnaireAnswerBody.title: QuestionnaireAnswerBody
QuestionnaireAnswerBody.description: POST /tax/questionnaire/answers: the answer and the rows it brings, written together.

QuestionnaireAnswerCreate.title: QuestionnaireAnswerCreate

QuestionnaireAnswerValue.title: QuestionnaireAnswerValue
QuestionnaireAnswerValue.description:
questionnaire_answer.answer (migration 0018, D110). not_applicable is recorded too, so
"answered no" differs from "not asked yet".

QuestionnaireSlot.title: QuestionnaireSlot
QuestionnaireSlot.description:
One slot of the viewed year: what last year leaves (QuestionPrefill) plus the slot's
current answer of this year, if any, so the screen can show it and correct it with a new
answer whose supersedes_id names it. The rows written with an answer are not linked to it;
the screen reads the slot's current rows from /return-inputs and the property's
/tax-inputs.

QuestionnaireView.title: QuestionnaireView
QuestionnaireView.description:
GET /tax/questionnaire: the year's questions and slots in file order (owners in name
order) and the progress. reused_from is set when the year has no file of its own. questions
are the file's (texts, answer type, choices, targets, carry-forward), each once; a slot
names its question by key, so the screen renders the question from the data, never from
its own copy (phase 4b §10, principle 5).

RateBasis.title: RateBasis
RateBasis.description: How a category's monthly rate was found (D155 (2)).

RateSegment.title: RateSegment
RateSegment.description:
The savings rate with the changes over consecutive months that share it and the
regular spending planned in them, Ā_regular + Δ(k) (§7.6 (4)).

RebookBlockReason.title: RebookBlockReason
RebookBlockReason.description:
Why an earlier line of the payee cannot be re-booked by „Diese auch auf … umbuchen“
(phase 6 D160, 14 Nov 2026), in the order the server checks: not_open (excluded, waiting
for a duplicate decision, or its import not reconciled), split (more than one row),
scoped (a property, unit, tenancy or loan), document (a Beleg), category (a code no rule
is learned for), linked (a leg of a transfer link or a depot movement).

RebookBlocker.title: RebookBlocker
RebookBlocker.description:
An earlier confirmed line of the payee that „Diese auch auf … umbuchen“ would refuse
to re-book (phase 6 D160): it must be changed by hand first. category: its one row's
category, or None for a split; a line already in the chosen category is not re-booked,
so it blocks nothing for that answer.

RecurringPayments.title: RecurringPayments
RecurringPayments.description:
GET /household/recurring (§7.9 (b) 5). `series`: the shown ones, price changes first;
`hidden`: the ones a person marked „kein Abo“. `count` and `yearly_total` are over the
shown active series (a series that may have ended is not counted). `yearly_detectable`
is false while the history is shorter than 350 days: no yearly series can be found yet.

RecurringSeries.title: RecurringSeries
RecurringSeries.description:
One payee paid at one interval (D296). `change` is the newest amount less the one the
series held before, with `since` the month of the first payment at the new amount; both
None without a price change. `sources` are the allocations behind it, oldest first;
`lines` the same payments for the panel (filled by the service).

RecurringState.title: RecurringState
RecurringState.description:
`active`: at most one interval without a payment; `maybe_ended`: two („Vielleicht
beendet“). Three or more: the series is left out of every list.

ReducedRentCheck.title: ReducedRentCheck
ReducedRentCheck.description:
§5.8 per Wohnung, monthly figures. market_warm = cold_rent_per_m2 × area + the year's
umlagefähige costs ÷ months owned. ratio_percent: agreed ÷ market_warm, one decimal; the
thresholds compare the exact ratio. cut_percent only below 50 %.

ReferenceRefreshQueued.title: ReferenceRefreshQueued
ReferenceRefreshQueued.description:
POST /household-goal/reference-returns/refresh, 202 (phase 10 §7.11 (c) 3, point 8):
the job that downloads route 3's funds series again for the household; `queued` false
when one already waits or runs, its id then that job's.

RelatedDocument.title: RelatedDocument
RelatedDocument.description:
GET /properties/{id}/documents and GET /units/{id}/documents: a document linked to the
target or to one of its children (units, tenancies, loans), with every such link.

ReminderKind.title: ReminderKind
ReminderKind.description: The catalogue's thirteen kinds (§6.2); the value is the reminder key.

RentModel.title: RentModel
RentModel.description: How rent changes over time. Term (befristet / unbefristet) is a separate field.

RentRowCorrection.title: RentRowCorrection
RentRowCorrection.description:
POST /rent-schedule/{row_id}/corrections: the correction row's values; an absent field
keeps the wrong row's value (correct_rent_row).

RentScheduleCreate.title: RentScheduleCreate
RentScheduleCreate.description: A dated rent row. Never edited: a wrong row is superseded by a correction row.

ReplacementFact.title: ReplacementFact
ReplacementFact.description: A benefit paid by an authority (D102); the employer's Zuschuss is on the certificate.

ReportTradesBooked.title: ReportTradesBooked
ReportTradesBooked.description:
POST /accounts/{id}/report-trades: how many trades were booked from the reports, how
many report prices that stored (D167 amended (c)), and the funds left out because their
holdings would not match the report (review of 15 Nov 2026).

RequirementCode.title: RequirementCode
RequirementCode.description: One kind of paperwork the return needs. German labels and hints live in the frontend.

Reserve.title: Reserve
Reserve.description: D237, D238, §5.2. Compared in euros, never in rounded months.

ReserveAccounts.title: ReserveAccounts
ReserveAccounts.description:
Accounts added to or removed from the reserve's default set (D237). Their kind
(bank_current, bank_savings, credit_card) is checked by the service, which sees them.

ReserveNeedBasis.title: ReserveNeedBasis
ReserveNeedBasis.description: What the reserve's monthly need is taken from (phase 10 D305).

RetentionHold.title: RetentionHold
RetentionHold.description: Why a retain_until date cannot be computed yet.

RetentionResult.title: RetentionResult
RetentionResult.description: Exactly one of retain_until / hold is set. retention_class is null only when untyped.

ReturnEstimate.title: ReturnEstimate
ReturnEstimate.description:
The whole-return estimate (§5.8, D101). result = assessed.total − withheld.total:
positive is a back-payment, negative a refund.

ReturnInputCreate.title: ReturnInputCreate
ReturnInputCreate.description:
One return input row as written. A correction is a new row with supersedes_id (a current
row of the same kind and year, and the same owner); withdrawn = true ends it. Rows are
never changed.

ReturnInputEvidence.title: ReturnInputEvidence
ReturnInputEvidence.description:
GET /return-inputs/{id}/evidence: the row's Beleg and, when the row was applied from a
pre-fill proposal, each value's page and quote (read-only, gap 3). `scrubbed` says the
proposal's values were removed 90 days after the decision (phase 2 D19), so only the Beleg
is left; `values` is then empty.

ReturnInputEvidenceValue.title: ReturnInputEvidenceValue
ReturnInputEvidenceValue.description:
One value of the pre-fill a row was applied from: where the document states it (page
and quote, when the model cited one) and what the user did with it on apply.

ReturnInputFact.title: ReturnInputFact
ReturnInputFact.description: A stored row as the rules see it (every row of the history, as TaxInputFact).

ReturnInputKind.title: ReturnInputKind
ReturnInputKind.description:
return_input.kind (migration 0018, phase 4b D97). Owner-scoped unless listed in
HOUSEHOLD_KINDS; read per year unless listed in SPANNING_KINDS (D110).

ReturnedPartner.title: ReturnedPartner
ReturnedPartner.description:
Phase 6 D162 amended (7): the other line of a returned payment booked as such (the
debit that left, or the credit that brought it back, on the same account).

ReturnedPaymentCreate.title: ReturnedPaymentCreate
ReturnedPaymentCreate.description:
POST /returns' body (D162 amended (7)): the debit that left and the credit that brought
it back, both bank lines of one private account. Both are booked as transfer parts by the
person's answer and linked to each other (a transfer_link on one account), so together they
count as nothing.

RuleMatcher.title: RuleMatcher
RuleMatcher.description:
What a rule matches on. No money field, by design: a rule never stores an amount.
Patterns are case-insensitive regular expressions searched in the normalized text.

SaleResult.title: SaleResult
SaleResult.description:
D88, D89. gain is None when the sale is outside §23 (taxable False); a negative gain is
a loss that is not offset ("nicht verrechenbar", sale_tax 0.00).

SaleToday.title: SaleToday
SaleToday.description:
„Gewinn bei Verkauf heute (Schätzung)“: rules.performance.sale.sale() for a sale in
today's year at today's value and loan balance (rules.performance.projection.sale_today;
sale() dates the sale 31 Dec of that year, so `taxable` is decided for that day).
net_proceeds = value − selling_costs − sale_tax − loan_balance; profit = net_proceeds +
the cash back so far − the own money put in. tax_not_computed: the sale is taxable with a
gain but no income input exists, so phase 4 cannot compute the §23 tax (its assumption
sale.tax_without_income) and sale_tax reads 0.00: net_proceeds and profit are then too
high by that tax, and the screen says so instead of showing 0,00 €.

SavingsPlan.title: SavingsPlan
SavingsPlan.description:
A savings plan detected from the last three closed months (D245): the same destination
in each of the three, monthly = the median of the three sums.

SavingsRate.title: SavingsRate
SavingsRate.description: D235, §5.1. Every ratio None when income ≤ 0.

ScheduleEntry.title: ScheduleEntry
ScheduleEntry.description:
interest = opening_balance * (nominal * (interest_days - follow_up_days)
+ follow_up * follow_up_days) / 360, rounded half-up (principle 2: traceable).

title.description: a short German title, two to six words naming what the document is

direction.description: Einbuchung or Ausbuchung, as printed in the heading

transfer_date.description: the day the units were moved (Handelsdatum, else the document's date)

reference.description: the document's reference number (Referenz-Nr.); never a depot number

positions.description: every security the document moves, one item per security, each written `ISIN | name | units`, as printed (the units without ST); never the WKN or a depot number

SecuritiesTransferExtraction.title: SecuritiesTransferExtraction
SecuritiesTransferExtraction.description:
Einbuchung / Ausbuchung von Wertpapieren (securities_transfer, step 4, §14.1): units
moved into or out of the depot without a trade. Both sides of one transfer carry the same
reference; the other depot named in the Hinweistext is scrubbed and never asked.

SeriesMarkRequest.title: SeriesMarkRequest
SeriesMarkRequest.description:
POST /household/recurring-marks: „kein Abo“ (`hidden`) or „Wieder anzeigen“
(`shown`) on a series, by its payee key and interval.

Session.title: Session
Session.description: The current session (Me.session). The cookie token is never part of any response.

SetOwnershipBody.title: SetOwnershipBody
SetOwnershipBody.description:
POST /accounts/{id}/ownership: the full current set. Σ = 1 and each owner once are
checked here; that each owner exists is the service's (ownership.owner_missing).

SettlementHint.title: SettlementHint
SettlementHint.description:
A line of a monthly category that is not an instalment (an electricity Jahresabrechnung,
a Hausgeldabrechnung's back-payment): not a rate, shown as a hint that the next instalment
may rise. `amount` is the cost (a refund is negative).

SnapshotRequest.title: SnapshotRequest
SnapshotRequest.description:
POST /net-worth/snapshots, optional body (phase 9 D241): a past month-end to store, from
31 Jan 2026 to the last one before today. Without it, the last month-end before today.

SpamVerdict.title: SpamVerdict
SpamVerdict.description:
POST /assets/{id}/promote and /demote: the token's verdict now and the number of
groups the flip changed (D187 (3)).

SpendingChange.title: SpendingChange
SpendingChange.description:
One planned change of a household spending code (D263, §7.6 (1)): a planned amount per
month, or a percent change of the code's measured mean, from a month and optionally to a
month. A group's fallback code stands for the whole group, its subcategories included; a
subcategory code for itself. `mean_at_save` is the code's mean (§7.6 (2)) the service
writes when a new or altered change is stored; a change carried unaltered from the row
superseded keeps the value stored with it (§7.6 (1) amended). A typed value is never read
(§7.7 reads the stored one).

SpendingComparison.title: SpendingComparison
SpendingComparison.description:
GET /household-plan/comparison?month= (§7.7): the default scenario in force on the
month's last day (today for the running month); `final` when the month has ended and is
closed, otherwise the figures are „bisher“ and `open_lines` wait in Zu prüfen. No colour,
no mark (D263 (e)).

SpendingComparisonRow.title: SpendingComparisonRow
SpendingComparisonRow.description: One code the scenario plans for the month (§7.7).

SpendingMarkAnswer.title: SpendingMarkAnswer
SpendingMarkAnswer.description:
A person's answer (§7.9 (f)): `one_off` and `regular` on a single payment (an
allocation, (c)); `hidden` („kein Abo“) and `shown` („Wieder anzeigen“) on a series (its
payee key and interval, (b)).

SpendingMarkRecorded.title: SpendingMarkRecorded
SpendingMarkRecorded.description: The answer as stored: the row's id and when.

SpendingPlay.title: SpendingPlay
SpendingPlay.description:
§7.6 (5): every code with a mean or a change, grouped; today's rate without one-offs;
the rate with the changes per stretch of months, never a mean of the months.

SpendingPlayGroup.title: SpendingPlayGroup
SpendingPlayGroup.description:
A spending group as the Haushalt screen groups it. `code`: the code that stands for the
whole group (its fallback, or its only code), None for a group that has neither (Steuerlich
relevant, Bewegungen, Depot); `changes`: the changes naming that code. The group's mean is
Σ of its rows; `change_first` holds the group's and the rows' changes of the first month.

SpendingPlayRow.title: SpendingPlayRow
SpendingPlayRow.description:
One spending code (§7.6 (5)): its measured mean (§7.6 (2)), the amount planned for the
first future month and its change against the mean, and the changes the levers hold for
it. `playable`: a change may name this code on its own row; a group's fallback code is
planned on the group's row (it stands for the whole group), and bank fees, uncategorised
lines and a refund count in the mean but are never planned (§7.6 (1)).

SplitMethod.title: SplitMethod
SplitMethod.description: matching_rule.split_method (D25): how a rule splits, never how much.

SplitPrefill.title: SplitPrefill
SplitPrefill.description:
§7.11 (f) 1: what the household bought per kind over the window (the closed months,
at most twelve), as shares that only fill the form. Purchases into an account of the
reserve's set are left out (D304).

SplitSource.title: SplitSource
SplitSource.description:
Where the effective split came from (§7.11 (a) 2): the saved lever, the continuing
savings plans' mix, today's holdings' mix, or nothing (nothing saved, planned or held).

StateCode.title: StateCode
StateCode.description:
owner.tax_state (migration 0016, phase 4 D90): the Bundesland whose church tax rate
applies (rules/tax/tariffs/<year>.yaml, church_tax_rates).

StatementAccountBody.title: StatementAccountBody
StatementAccountBody.description:
POST /documents/{id}/statement-account, „Konto anlegen und einlesen“: what the person
sets for the new account. The kind, the IBAN or number and the opening balance come from
the stored file on the server, never from the browser (the D176 (4) pattern). `shares`
as POST /accounts/{id}/ownership takes them (D157); empty leaves the to-do „Eigentümer
festlegen“.

StatementAccountCreated.title: StatementAccountCreated
StatementAccountCreated.description:
The account „Konto anlegen und einlesen“ created and the file's import onto it, both
written in one transaction. Since 14 Nov 2026 the other statement files waiting under
Dokumente that print the same IBAN or number are imported with it, in statement order
(`other_imported`); one whose import refuses keeps its offer (`other_refused`).

title.description: a short German title, two to six words naming what the document is

StatementExtraction.title: StatementExtraction
StatementExtraction.description:
PDF Kontoauszug (§7.1): balances and lines. Every amount is a model reading, so the
reconciliation is the guard; `lines` holds one text per booking line, parsed into
StatementLines by bank.pdf.

StatementFileCandidate.title: StatementFileCandidate
StatementFileCandidate.description:
An account of the kind the file imports onto that may take it: its number is the one
the file prints, or it has none yet (its first statement sets it).

StatementFileImport.title: StatementFileImport
StatementFileImport.description: One import of a stored document: the account it went to (GET /documents/{id}).

StatementFileOffer.title: StatementFileOffer
StatementFileOffer.description:
A statement file uploaded through Dokumente (a credit card's PDF statement, a depot's
cash statement or, since 13 Nov 2026, a bank's own export: camt, Sparkasse CSV, DKB CSV),
whose read failed with proposal.bank_file_not_read and which no account holds yet: the
accounts it can be imported onto with „Auf Konto importieren“ (principle 7: the app
proposes, the person confirms). `suggested_account_id` is the account whose stored number
or IBAN is the one the file prints, else the only candidate; none when there is no
candidate or several without a number. No candidate means no account of this kind takes
it yet (`account_kind` names the kind to create). `new_account` is set whenever no account
holds the file's own IBAN or number and the file holds a booked line, also beside
candidates without a number (a second depot), for „Konto anlegen und einlesen“.

StatementNewAccount.title: StatementNewAccount
StatementNewAccount.description:
„Konto anlegen und einlesen“ (phase 6, 13 Nov 2026, amends D176 (3) and D165 (b)): the
account the file's own content implies, offered when no account holds the file's IBAN or
number yet. The kind comes from the format; `bank`, `provider` and `label` are suggestions
the person edits (None where the format does not tell, e.g. a camt file); the identifier is
shown masked only (an IBAN as „DE89 **** 3000“, a number as „**** 4567“) and never travels
back from the browser: POST /documents/{id}/statement-account reads it from the original.

StatementRefusal.title: StatementRefusal
StatementRefusal.description:
A statement file the app tried to import onto its account by itself and the import
refused (phase 6, 14 Nov 2026): the document keeps its „Auf Konto importieren“ offer, and
`code` is the import's statement.* (or other rule) code, which says why.

StatementTradeKeep.title: StatementTradeKeep
StatementTradeKeep.description: Which reading „Kontoauszug und Abrechnung weichen ab“ keeps (D292 amended (b)).

StatementsRefusal.title: StatementsRefusal
StatementsRefusal.description:
The bank's latest unresolved refusal of the PDF statement fetch because the access may
not fetch statements at all (account.statements_refused, 14 Nov 2026): its answer code,
the statement asked and when. Ends once a later run's HKEKP is answered without it.

Surplus.title: Surplus
Surplus.description:
§6.1. Free cash is the sum of the three rounded means (D244); the buffer is 0 when the
free cash is not positive; investable = max(0, free cash − buffer).

SurplusKey.title: SurplusKey
SurplusKey.description: The rows of „So entsteht die Zahl“, in this order (D244, §6.1).

SyncStatus.title: SyncStatus
SyncStatus.description: bank_sync.status (migration 0019, D118). done, nothing_new and failed are final.

SyncTrigger.title: SyncTrigger
SyncTrigger.description: bank_sync.trigger (migration 0019): a person's button or the daily schedule (D120).

TariffStamp.title: TariffStamp
TariffStamp.description: Which tariff a figure was computed with (shown with every projection).

TaxBreakdown.title: TaxBreakdown
TaxBreakdown.description:
T(zvE) of D82: Einkommensteuer (splitting, whole euros), Soli and church tax (cents).
Under a phase 4b household context (D98) it is the assessed tax: est after the
Günstigerprüfung, less the §35a credit (credit_35a, 0 on the plain tariff).

TaxEffect.title: TaxEffect
TaxEffect.description:
D82: effect = T(zvE_base + R) − T(zvE_base), or R × rate under an override (then the
two breakdowns are None). effective_rate = effect ÷ R in percent, one decimal half-up,
None for R = 0; slope (display only) is the tariff's slope at zvE_base including Soli and
church tax, shown when R = 0.

TaxExport.title: TaxExport
TaxExport.description:
A stored export (immutable). The draft it was built from is in the row's `draft`
column; the API returns it with the file's signed download URL, not inline.

TaxExportQueued.title: TaxExportQueued
TaxExportQueued.description:
POST /properties/{id}/anlage-v/exports or /owners/{id}/anlage-n/exports: the id to poll
GET /tax-exports/{id} with.

TaxExportState.title: TaxExportState
TaxExportState.description:
GET /tax-exports/{id}. `export` and `download_url` once ready; the URL is signed and
valid DOWNLOAD_TTL_S seconds, so a client fetches it right before downloading. An Anlage
N sheet names its owner, every other export its property (exactly one is set).

TaxInput.title: TaxInput
TaxInput.description: API read model (the table names its timestamp recorded_at, so not Record).

TaxInputCreate.title: TaxInputCreate
TaxInputCreate.description:
One tax input row as written. A correction is a new row with supersedes_id (the row it
replaces, a current row of the same kind and scope); withdrawn = true ends a decision
without replacing it (its value repeats the withdrawn row's). Rows are never changed.

TaxRateResult.title: TaxRateResult
TaxRateResult.description:
GET /api/tax-rate: the Steuern screen's "Steuerwirkung" line (§8, §9).

zve and effect are None together when no income input applies to the year or an earlier
one (`missing`, the flag income.missing: the screen shows "— · Einkommen eintragen").
owner_estimates lists each owner's gross pay, deductions (the D84 default or the typed
override) and estimate from the rows that apply, whatever the year's source, so the
Eigentümer page can show the computed default deductions under a Bescheid or an override
too.

TelecomComponent.title: TelecomComponent
TelecomComponent.description: §5.5: min(bills × share, cap_monthly × months) − employer reimbursement, floored at 0.

TenancyCreateRequest.title: TenancyCreateRequest
TenancyCreateRequest.description: POST /tenancies: TenancyCreate plus the first rent row (create_tenancy's initial_rent).

TenancyFlatRate.title: TenancyFlatRate
TenancyFlatRate.description:
One flat_rate tenancy in force on `as_of` (D155 (3), (4)).

`pauschale` is the rent row in force today's operating_costs_prepayment; `set_on` the date
it was set (the latest rent-schedule row in force that changed it, else the tenancy's
start). `changes` per FLAT_RATE_CATEGORIES compare the levels on `set_on` and today;
`flat_rise` is Σ of the BetrKV changes; `rise` = flat_rise × pauschale ÷ Σ Pauschalen,
half-up to the cent (0.00 when the Pauschalen sum to 0). `share_percent` is that share for
display only, one decimal; the rise is never computed from it. `earliest_start` (raise
only) is the first day of the month after next from `as_of` (§560 Abs. 2 BGB);
`fell_on` (lower only) the date the cost fell (§560 Abs. 3 BGB): of the BetrKV categories
whose rate fell, the earliest date from which its rate today applies (the first line of the
unbroken run of lines at today's rate; a schedule's 1 January).

`recorded_from` and `recorded_pauschale` (both or neither): the first rent row dated after
`as_of` that changes the Pauschale, a change already recorded (such as the pre-filled
„Mietänderung“). The verdict is then none (no to-do, no letter, no pre-fill), whatever the
rise; today's Pauschale stays in `pauschale` and the shares until the row takes effect.

TenancyPartiesBody.title: TenancyPartiesBody
TenancyPartiesBody.description: PUT /tenancies/{id}/parties: the whole list (exactly one primary; service rule).

TenancyPatch.title: TenancyPatch
TenancyPatch.description:
PATCH /tenancies/{id}: the non-milestone fields. Move-in, move-out, notice and contract
date change through their corrections, the parties through PUT .../parties.

Tenant.title: Tenant
Tenant.description: Read shape. After erasure every personal field is null and erased_at is set.

TimelineEntry.title: TimelineEntry
TimelineEntry.description: One milestone. For a correction chain A → B → C only one entry appears, showing C.

TrackedAmount.title: TrackedAmount
TrackedAmount.description: Booked, not deductible this year (Tilgung, Erhaltungsrücklage).

title.description: a short German title, two to six words naming what the document is

trade_date.description: the trade date (Handelstag, Schlusstag), without the time

settlement_date.description: the settlement date (Valuta), from the sentence on the booking

side.description: Kauf or Verkauf, as printed in the heading under Wertpapierabrechnung

fees.description: the fees charged on this trade, summed without sign: Bank-Provision, Courtage, Spesen and Gebühren

taxes.description: the German taxes deducted on this trade, summed without sign: Kapitalertragsteuer, Solidaritätszuschlag and Kirchensteuer from the tax section; 0,00 when none

net_amount.description: the amount debited or credited to the cash account, without sign (Ausmachender Betrag; on a sale after the taxes)

currency.description: the currency of the amounts, as a three-letter code

order_reference.description: the document's reference number (Referenz-Nr.); never a depot or account number

TradeConfirmationExtraction.title: TradeConfirmationExtraction
TradeConfirmationExtraction.description: Wertpapierabrechnung (trade_confirmation, D165 (2)): one buy or sell of one security.

Transaction.title: Transaction
Transaction.description:
Read shape. The counterparty IBAN is shown masked only. allocation_status and
allocation_categories are computed on read, never stored: the distinct categories of
the line's current allocation rows, the largest amount first.

TransactionAllocationStatus.title: TransactionAllocationStatus

TransactionAllocations.title: TransactionAllocations
TransactionAllocations.description:
GET / PUT /transactions/{id}/allocations: the line, its current allocation rows
(proposed or confirmed; none = not matched) and the rule checkbox.

can_learn_rule: whether a single-category answer for this line can become a rule
without a typed pattern (false without an IBAN, and for a counterparty a matcher owns,
D38). learn_rule_default: the checkbox's default for the current rows (off when a rule
cannot be learned from them, or a category never auto-confirms, review F6).
no_default_rule_categories: the categories that never auto-confirm (threshold None in
rules.review.THRESHOLDS), in taxonomy order, so the UI can default the checkbox for rows
the person types (on unless one of these is among them, §8.1).
waiting_other_amounts (D49): when a rule can be learned, the other amounts of the lines
still waiting from the same IBAN hash and sign (reconciled import, not a duplicate, no
confirmed row), each with its count, most frequent first, at most five; the panel then
asks whether those belong to the same category (same_amount_only).
waiting_other_count, waiting_same_amount_count: how many such lines wait in all with
another amount than this line's and with the same amount, uncapped, so the panel says
how many waiting lines the rule would book (a payee with many different amounts showed
only five of them, 14 Nov 2026).
unlearnable_categories: the categories the line's account takes for which a one-row
answer can never become a rule, with or without a typed pattern (phase 6 D160 on a
private account as amended (5): uncategorized, the transfer and depot codes, a
property bill, work and education; empty on the rental account), in taxonomy order, so
the UI shows no rule box instead of letting rule.not_learnable refuse the answer.
rule: the rule this PUT created, if any.
name_history (phase 6 D160): for a private line whose rule would be on its name (no
IBAN, or a shared one), the payee's other confirmed lines of the same sign by category,
most frequent first: what rebook_earlier would re-book. rebook_blockers: with a
name_history, the payee's earlier confirmed lines rebook_earlier would refuse to re-book
(rule.rebook_blocked), oldest first, so the panel names them instead of offering it.
rebooked: how many earlier lines this PUT re-booked.
suggested_purpose_pattern (14 Nov 2026, principle 7): for a line without an IBAN whose
answer cannot become a rule on its own (can_learn_rule false) and whose current rows are
one row of a category a typed pattern learns on this account, `^` + the purpose's first
word of at least six letters, regex-escaped, when the rule a PUT with it would create
hits no line with an IBAN and none confirmed under another category or as a split; the
panel then offers the rule box with this pattern, and learn_rule_default is computed with
it. None otherwise. suggested_pattern_waiting: how many waiting lines (as in
waiting_amount_counts, this line excluded, on accounts of its purpose) that rule would
book.
payee_label (phase 6 D160 amended (4), 14 Nov 2026): for a payment service's line
(PayPal, Klarna) the service and the merchant it names („PayPal: DisneyPlus“), whose
lines the rule books; None for any other line. no_merchant: a payment service's line
whose merchant cannot be read, so no rule is learned from it (rule.no_merchant) and the
panel shows no rule box. own_iban (D160 amended (5), review fixes, 15 Nov 2026): a
private line whose counterparty IBAN is another own account's, always a transfer, so no
rule is learned from it, typed pattern or not (rule.not_learnable), and the panel shows
no rule box, no suggested pattern and no pattern field, as for no_merchant.
deposit_iban_offer (phase 6 D162 amended (8), review, 15 Nov 2026): what the box „IBAN
als Einzahlungskonto von <Börse> merken“ names, None when no box is shown (no current link
to an exchange's deposit, or the IBAN would not be learned: the exchange holds one, it
carries other payees, another own account holds it).

TransferLegSource.title: TransferLegSource
TransferLegSource.description: Which table a transfer leg is a row of (phase 6 D162).

TransferLegView.title: TransferLegView
TransferLegView.description: One leg as the screens show it: its account by label, never an IBAN.

TransferLinkCreate.title: TransferLinkCreate
TransferLinkCreate.description: POST /transfers (a link by hand): exactly one out and one in leg.

TransferLinkKind.title: TransferLinkKind
TransferLinkKind.description:
transfer_link.kind (migration 0025; chain, bridge and wrap since 0041, phase 7 D184).
A link by hand (TransferLinkCreate) of two EUR legs takes the kind rules.matching
.transfer_link_kind gives the two accounts; of two coin legs (phase 7 step 5,
services.chain.transfers) the kind rules.chain.match_transfer reads from the legs.

TransferLinkRequest.title: TransferLinkRequest
TransferLinkRequest.description:
POST /transfers' body. rebook (D176 (4), review of step 2b): a leg booked as something
other than a transfer (typically a card bill answered hh_credit_card before the card
account existed) is first re-booked as internal_transfer_out or _in by the person's answer
(method user: the click is the confirmation), then the two are linked. Allowed only for a
bank line tied to the other leg by an own IBAN (one leg names the other's account IBAN or
the card's confirmed payment IBAN); otherwise transfer.legs_invalid.

TransferLinkView.title: TransferLinkView
TransferLinkView.description: GET /transfers?month=: a current link with both legs.

TransferUnlinkBody.title: TransferUnlinkBody
TransferUnlinkBody.description:
POST /transfers/{id}/unlink: the link that replaces the wrong one (append-only, D162:
the old row names the new one in superseded_by).

TypedPriceBody.title: TypedPriceBody
TypedPriceBody.description:
POST /assets/{id}/prices: a price typed by a person („Kurs eintragen“, source user;
it wins on its own day, D167 amended 13 Nov 2026).

UnitRow.title: UnitRow
UnitRow.description:
One Z13 row per Wohnung (D71): the flat (wohnung = property) with its rooms listed, or an
MFH unit (wohnung = unit). pre_handover: the part booked before the handover (D63).
area_m2 None: an ETW or EFH with no Wohnfläche and no units, so no area is known; the
to-do income.living_area_missing asks for it (phase 2 D139).

UnvaluedToken.title: UnvaluedToken
UnvaluedToken.description:
A token held but not shown in the value (spam, or no price source), listed so the
statement still accounts for every unit (D187).

UsefulLife.title: UsefulLife
UsefulLife.description:
§7 Abs. 4 S. 2 EStG (D79): the building's shorter actual useful life in whole years, as
the Gutachten (document_id on the row) states it; tax_year on the row is the first tax year
it applies to. The service refuses a life not shorter than the statutory one.

ValueChange.title: ValueChange
ValueChange.description:
The yearly change of a class's value without its distributions (§7.5 (10)), typed by
a member. Neither field has a default value or an example: an empty field means no
projection, a typed 0 is a rate (D247 amended).

Verdict.title: Verdict
Verdict.description: GET /health's `verdict`: computed on read from the same figures, never stored.

VerdictPart.title: VerdictPart
VerdictPart.description:
One of the three questions: its figure, its state against the limits used, and where
each limit came from. The savings rate and the Schuldendienstquote are ratios (`value`,
`good`, `strained`); the reserve is compared in euros (`amount` against `target`, good at
or above it, strained below `strained_amount` = `strained` × target). Texts are German,
figure-free, from verdict.yaml; the English is swapped in on read (services/read_texts).

VerdictWord.title: VerdictWord
VerdictWord.description: The household's financial health in one word (rules/verdict).

WageCertificate.title: WageCertificate
WageCertificate.description:
The confirmed figures of one Lohnsteuerbescheinigung (§5.1). A line the model did not
read is 0 with its field listed under `unread` (the review lets the user type it).

title.description: a short German title, two to six words naming what the document is

employee_name.description: the employee's name, to match the owner

church_tax.description: Nr. 6 Einbehaltene Kirchensteuer des Arbeitnehmers von 3.

church_tax_spouse.description: Nr. 7 Einbehaltene Kirchensteuer des Ehegatten von 3.

replacement_benefits.description: Nr. 15 Kurzarbeitergeld, Zuschuss zum Mutterschaftsgeld und ähnliche

employer_commute_tax_free.description: Nr. 17 Steuerfreie Arbeitgeberleistungen für Fahrten zwischen Wohnung und erster Tätigkeitsstätte

employer_commute_flat_taxed.description: Nr. 18 Pauschal besteuerte Arbeitgeberleistungen für Fahrten zwischen Wohnung und erster Tätigkeitsstätte

subsidy_health.description: Nr. 24a Steuerfreie Arbeitgeberzuschüsse zur gesetzlichen Krankenversicherung

subsidy_private_health.description: Nr. 24b Steuerfreie Arbeitgeberzuschüsse zur privaten Krankenversicherung

subsidy_care.description: Nr. 24c Steuerfreie Arbeitgeberzuschüsse zur gesetzlichen Pflegeversicherung

WageCertificateExtraction.title: WageCertificateExtraction
WageCertificateExtraction.description: Lohnsteuerbescheinigung: one employer's certificate for one year.

WaitingAmount.title: WaitingAmount
WaitingAmount.description: An amount other lines from the same IBAN and sign are waiting with, and how many.

WaitingCoin.title: WaitingCoin
WaitingCoin.description:
One coin's units a wallet's proposed movements hold (signed: Σ of the live proposed
legs, fees included; positive = not yet counted, negative = not yet taken off).

WalletAddressBody.title: WalletAddressBody
WalletAddressBody.description:
POST /wallets/{id}/addresses (WalletAddressCreate's fields): a validation error never
echoes the pasted address. `also_on` takes EVM chains only, for an Ethereum address the
shortcut „Auch auf Arbitrum und BNB Smart Chain lesen“ (D179 (2)).

WalletAddressPatch.title: WalletAddressPatch
WalletAddressPatch.description:
PATCH /wallets/{id}/addresses/{aid}: the label (null clears it) and active (false
retires the address, true reactivates it). Nothing else of a row ever changes (0041's
trigger).

WalletAddressPlain.title: WalletAddressPlain
WalletAddressPlain.description:
GET /wallets/{id}/addresses/{aid}/plain: the full address for „kopieren“, sent with
Cache-Control: no-store and audited as wallet.address_revealed. The page writes it to the
clipboard and never renders it.

WalletAddressState.title: WalletAddressState
WalletAddressState.description:
One address's state on the wallet page, from its last finished `wallet_sync` row and
its chain's source as configured now (services/wallet_cards.address_statuses).

WalletAddressStatus.title: WalletAddressStatus
WalletAddressStatus.description:
An address's state in plain German (`text`) with what to do (`todo`), and the
Scaleway container variable to set or check (`setting`) when the cure is one.

WalletAnswer.title: WalletAnswer
WalletAnswer.description:
A person's answer to a proposed group (D183 (5)), built for groups whose legs all go
one way: „Bezahlung“ (out: a disposal), „Geschenk oder Zahlung erhalten“ (in: an
acquisition at a typed cost, 0 when 0 is typed, unknown (NULL, D188) when none is),
„Belohnung“ (in: a staking reward) and „Spam“ (in, tokens the registry does not list and
the household does not hold only: hidden from then on, D187). „Tausch“ and
„Übertrag an eigene Wallet/Börse“ need the legs picked and a transfer link (step 5).

WalletAnsweredGroup.title: WalletAnsweredGroup
WalletAnsweredGroup.description:
GET /wallets/{id}/answered: a live group a person answered or confirmed, its legs in
plain words. `undoable`: „Antwort zurücknehmen“ applies (no transfer link touches its
legs); it re-proposes the transaction as the sync first classified it.

WalletCardKind.title: WalletCardKind
WalletCardKind.description: What a live proposed movement group asks of a person.

WalletGroup.title: WalletGroup
WalletGroup.description:
GET /wallets/{id}/groups: one card per open group (D183 (1)): live and proposed, or
holding a live proposed leg (a leg a later sync added to an answered group). `text`,
`confirmable` and `answers` are about its proposed legs: „Bestätigen“ keeps them as they
stand (no question, no leg left uncategorized); `answers` are the corrections that fit
them. `legs` lists every live leg, each with its status.

WalletGroupAnswerBody.title: WalletGroupAnswerBody
WalletGroupAnswerBody.description:
POST /groups/{gid}/answer. `cost_eur` only with `gift` and one leg: the acquisition's
cost; a gift is typed as 0. Without it the cost stays unknown (NULL): the lots price it by
the day or show „Kurs fehlt“ (D183 (5), D188).

WalletGroupDone.title: WalletGroupDone
WalletGroupDone.description: The group that now stands for the transaction (the same id after „Bestätigen“).

WalletHolding.title: WalletHolding
WalletHolding.description:
One asset's balance on the chain at the last read beside what Hausbuch books for it
(D186 (2)). `address_id` is None when the chain reconciles the wallet's addresses
together (Bitcoin). `booked_units` is the chain's balance less the stored difference,
None while the run waits for an answer (the difference is then not stored).

WalletPage.title: WalletPage
WalletPage.description:
GET /wallets/{id}: the wallet account with its owner shares, its addresses (masked,
active first, then by chain and the order added, each with its last finished sync), and
the balances and syncs, still empty: the runs are GET /wallets/{id}/syncs, the balances
the screens step's.

WalletState.title: WalletState
WalletState.description:
GET /wallets/{id}/state: each address's state, the holdings per asset at the last
read, and the live proposed groups of the wallet (those with a question among them).

WalletSyncQueued.title: WalletSyncQueued
WalletSyncQueued.description: POST /wallets/{id}/sync: „Jetzt abrufen“ queued for the wallet's active addresses.

WalletSyncRun.title: WalletSyncRun
WalletSyncRun.description:
One address's run (a wallet_sync row). `balances` and `difference` are base units per
asset (the contract, or `native`), as strings. `reconciled` null with `balances` set:
every differing asset is named by an open question („wartet auf Antwort“), or the
account's next address in the same run carries the account's verdict; `balances` null on
a succeeded run: the budget ended first (`wallet.sync_deferred`), or the balance read
failed after a run that stored something new (its code is in the run's event and log,
not on the row); a balance read that fails with nothing new is a failed, throttled or
refused row with its `error_code`. On an account-scope source (Bitcoin) the account's
verdict is the newest row with `reconciled` not null among the account's addresses on
that chain; when the run's last address failed, the earlier rows stay null and the
failed row is what the wallet shows.

WalletWaiting.title: WalletWaiting
WalletWaiting.description:
A wallet whose movements were read but wait for a person (a first sync proposes the
whole history, D186 (1)): the Krypto tab, the Anlagen overview and the net worth count
confirmed movements only, so these coins are missing there until confirmed (principle 7:
the gap as a plain to-do with its link; 16 Nov 2026). Never an address or a hash (D179).

Window.title: Window
Window.description: The unbroken run of closed months ending at the newest, cut to 12 (D231).

title.description: a short German title, two to six words naming what the document is

valid_from.description: first month the plan applies to

iban.description: the WEG account the Hausgeld is paid to

WirtschaftsplanExtraction.title: WirtschaftsplanExtraction
WirtschaftsplanExtraction.description: Wirtschaftsplan: the monthly Hausgeld split the by_wirtschaftsplan rule reads (§8.1).

WithdrawalsConfirmed.title: WithdrawalsConfirmed
WithdrawalsConfirmed.description:
POST /movement-imports/{id}/withdrawals/confirm: „Alle Auszahlungen gingen an eigene
Wallets“ (D178 (4)); how many proposed withdrawals of the import it confirmed.

WorkRoomComponent.title: WorkRoomComponent
WorkRoomComponent.description: §5.4: the flat rate (a twelfth per month) against the room's share of the costs.

WorkRoomFact.title: WorkRoomFact
WorkRoomFact.description: The häusliches Arbeitszimmer (D106): Jahrespauschale or actual costs by the m² share.

Workspace.title: Workspace
Workspace.description: One household. Every other table carries workspace_id and is filtered by RLS.

WorkspaceSettings.title: WorkspaceSettings
WorkspaceSettings.description: GET /workspace/settings. All three default to false (D16, D26; phase 5 D123).

YearFigures.title: YearFigures
YearFigures.description:
One year of the actuals card and the projection table (§5.3). The figures are sums of
confirmed, non-zero allocations of the year by §11 (projected years: of the synthesized
rows and the real lines §11 puts into that year).

YearTotals.title: YearTotals
YearTotals.description: Per calendar year of due_on. Interest here is what Anlage V will reconcile against.

title.description: a short German title, two to six words naming what the document is

ZinsbescheinigungExtraction.title: ZinsbescheinigungExtraction
ZinsbescheinigungExtraction.description: Zinsbescheinigung: the year's interest, reconciled against the loan schedule.

ZveEstimate.title: ZveEstimate
ZveEstimate.description:
zvE_base (D83, D84): the household's taxable income without this property. amount is
None only under a rate override with nothing else entered for the year.

hausbuch__schemas__ai__SourceRef.title: SourceRef
hausbuch__schemas__ai__SourceRef.description:
Where a value came from: the page (1-indexed, page offset of a split PDF already
added) and the cited text, verbatim.

hausbuch__schemas__tax__SourceRef.title: SourceRef
hausbuch__schemas__tax__SourceRef.description:
What a figure came from (principle 2). `rule` is the rule set and `tariff` the income
tax tariff file (no id); every other kind names its record.
